text: The orange chicken meal is really good. I really enjoyed the spicy sauce they add to the orange chicken. The spicy sauce is perfection. Its not easy to find a good restaurant that can give a really good spicy level to the chicken like this place. And OMG the TOM YUM SOUP was super amazingly delicious and tasty! 😍 the mushroom in the soup was perfect! It was my first time trying this soup 🍲 and it was exquisite 😍. The whole meal was really good. I also enjoyed the Thai Ice Tea. The seats and place is really clean and comfortable to dine in. I appreciate the service here. Thank you.
Insane value- i got all this for $12 + $5 thai tea from their lunch special! They definitely deserve more business, and we should support local more often. Yummy!

A new place for me. I love soup, and this place did not disappoint. Good size portions and very flavorful. The staff are friendly and accommodating. The menu options are great. Curry 🍛 is one of my favorite Thai dishes and I really like there panang curry. There is parking on the street, a lot to the south and behind. Wheelchair accessible on both sides. The decorations keep me entranced and I forget to read the menu.

Ordered chicken pad thai, pineapple fried rice, spicy (drunken) noodles, and spicy beef salad. Everything tasted fine, except the spicy drunken noodles itself was a bit overcooked, and was a bit clumpy, I never had that experience at other Thai places. Maybe the rice noodles were frozen and thawed. But the flavor was good. Will definitely be back next time when cravings hit.

Amazing value—I purchased everything at $12 plus $5 for Thai tea as part of their lunch special! They undoubtedly deserve more business, and we ought to patronize local businesses more frequently. Delicious!
Small place, delicious food, good service. Their Pad Thai is bomb, only downside is parking cause is a little limited. But it's worth checking out.

Quaint little family-owned Thai restaurant. I had the lunch special, and everything was really delicious and very reasonably priced. The amount of food you get for the price is actually pretty incredible. Will definitely be back.

This is such a good, hole-in-the-wall Thai spot! My partner loved his Kung Pao Chicken with Fried Rice and my Pad Thai was actually one of the best I've had. Plus with the good portions and the lunch special, it was a great deal! The staff was really nice, our waiter noticed that I chose tofu as my protein and he let me know that the soup had a meat base in case I was vegetarian, which was very thoughtful. I give the food, the price, and the service all 5 stars - we'll be back to try more dishes!

The soup was really tasty especially with the fish sauce they have, my son loved their chow mein very flavorful and I loved my pad see ew it was perfect over all the place was really clean the service was great the guy their was very attentive and friendly will definitely stop by again

Nice crispy orange chicken that you can actually taste the citrus of the orange but still slightly sweet 😋 Came with a side of rice. The Mongolian beef was also savory, good amount of veggies and meat. Though if u prefer more meat this won't have enough for you. They have regular and chicken egg rolls same size for both. Boba thai tea was good and not too sweet like other places. Great place to go 💫

Hi im from Las Vegas and my experience with this place wasn't the best. There was a lady that gave me a very disturbing look when I walked in. Im sure she works there, and the cashier was...doing his best to be kind. Overall a very uncomfortable environment and the the food was ok.

Update never mind they just moved locations thank goodness!!! Spicy noodle with tofu level 3, appetizers and orange chicken are my usual go to’s! I’m so sad to hear that this place has closed. Amazing food and great service.

Love this place! Go there with my co-workers all the time for lunch. Great dishes prepared well, very friendly service, and a relaxed casual atmosphere. Do recommend for a quick lunch. The spicy sauces are done right, too. The vinegar/Thai chili pepper one will kick your butt. Try their lunch specials!

What a great find. Jenny‘s thai was perfect. They even altered something on the starter menu for us which was really kind to suit our needs. Great flavours, great food, great service, even checked our vaccine proof to rest in. I would definitely recommend
Food Is ok ordered pa ka pow and thought it was minced meat but it was just slices of meat. I was disappointed. Never coming back. There’s a better spot by the 170 up sepulveda they never disappoint.

We ordered delivery for the second time. The food was fantastic again!! I've tried many different Thai restaurants in the last year since we moved to Northridge and so glad we found this spot in Granada Hills!! The flavor is on point!! So many other places are hit and miss!! Everything we ordered is excellent! Beef spicy noodles (aka drunken noodles), shrimp pad woon sen, shrimp & tofu green curry extra eggplant, tom kha seafood soup & shrimp pad see ew. Shrimp, fish and excetera were all fresh!! Next time we will dine in!! This will be our to go place for Thai!! The guy that took our order was nice! Delivery was fast and on time for a large order! Give them a try... you won't be disappointed!!

Nice and clean, still open when most everything else on the block wasn't. Thankfully! As I had been dreaming of Thai ice tea all day, had two! Service a little slow, all my needs were met, except a place to charge my phone ( everywhere can't be Starbucks ).

This is a small family owed restaurant and casual. I love that they have booths. The food is very fresh, flavorful, delicious, and home cooking. The serving portions are great and the prices reasonable. It’s the only restaurant I have ever been to that if I didn’t write a review, I would have felt guilty. :). It’s that much of a find. The family is hard working and humble as they provide comfort food.

Three words to best describe my experience at Spice Up Thai? WILL COME BACK !!! Shout to Nikki! For his outstanding hospitality the moment I enter the door!(keep in mind it was closing time !) but yet he still was eager to take my order and I got my Thai food craving fulfilled thanks to SPICE UP THAI!!!

Our usual Thai place was full so we decided to come here. So glad we did!! The food is amazing!!! So many options and so much flavor. Options for everyone. I personally got the yellow curry with tofu and it was a 11/10. It seems like everything is freshly made and according to the people I dined with, even the seafood tasted fresh. The service was excellent and our waiters were very attentive and amicable. Highly recommend to anyone who's in the valley. The only downside is that if you dine in during a hot day, it seems they don't turn on the AC full blast or just use fans so maybe consider take out over dine in. Otherwise, try it!!
recommended_dishes: Soup, Kung Pao Chicken with Fried Rice, Red Curry

text: Hidden Gem 😍 Just find out this place great food clean restaurant kind customer service got spicy beef fried rice awesome love this place
Amazing Thai food. I will definitely be back

For the cost of the food for take out and the additional charges 3+$ for anything extra: chicken , meat, veggies, shrimp, rice, tofu, “salad”…. you would think it would have been great. I paid additional for mixed veggies and received extra onion strips … I asked for a side salad and received 1 big piece of lettuce with 3 carrots and 2 pieces of cucumber. Paid extra for a fried egg and rice, the egg was delicious , the rice was enough for 1 person but if you are getting for more than 1 person you’re going to pay a lot more than you think you would. The soup wasn’t even that flavored, I’m disappointed. .
Ordered the chicken larb. Great lunch deal at less than $12 and I was full and content by the end.

I love this place. If you like Thai food, this is Authentic and EPIC. The Spicy noodle is to die for. The Tom yum and Tom kha soup are AMAZING, and my personal favorite is the Pad see ew (with beef but chicken rocks too!) The service is always friendly and the food is always fresh. Stop by, get some great food and don't forget the Thai tea!

If you’re looking for a cozy place with great food, this is it. The portions are a good size and everything I’ve tried has been delicious. I’ve had almost everything on the menu, and it never disappoints. If you’re in Mission Hills, I definitely recommend stopping by.

I simply LOVE this place. Food is delicious, the workers are lovely, and it is cheap cheap cheap! Not the quality, the price! This little hole in the wall is a GEM in our town. Lunch specials are very cheap and have a variety of selections to choose from. My personal favorite is yellow curry. I also love their coconut soup. If mango and sticky rice is in season, DEFINITELY get it. It is a delicious and refreshing dessert that you wont regret. The interior of the restaurant is cute, it seems like every time I go in there they have some new art to hang on the wall. Its typically quiet and peaceful inside the restaurant. Definitely try, Spice Up Thai!

Surprisingly good Thai food! Honestly, I wouldn't have expected that here in Mission Hills. The Spicy Beef salad is really well done, and it has good spice and flavor. The Pad Prik King is also pretty good..which I tried it with chicken. I will be happily coming back. The menu is fairly diverse, prices are average for a Thai place...moderately priced. The decor isn't the best, but some of that is owed I suppose to the fact the restaurant occupies part of a strip mall in a not so hot area. And, that is probably what makes the restaurant and the food more remarkable. It isn't great, but it definitely is good. Seriously, the Spicy Beef salad is delicious.. :)

My favorite Thai restaurant in the valley. The food is delicious (from the Spice Up Fresh Rolls, to the curries, to the delicious Tom Yum)! The service is great, and the staff is very friendly. Parking is a pain, but it's worth it. If you're looking for truly authentic Thai Food, definitely give this little local gem a try. If you're a meat eater, try the beef jerky, you'll be glad you did!

I cannot rave enough about Jenny's Thai Restaurant! The chef behind all this fabulous food is affable, smart, outstanding - husband Pat. They are an excellent team, care about their customers, the place is immaculate, and they will do anything to please their customers with the BEST! My family and I have frequented their place for 20 Years - even when they were in a previous location. We just followed them. They're WORTH IT! I give them FIVE STARS!!!

Update since this is no longer Jenny's Thai. I still had a pretty good experience, they took my order the same, though the food and service is not the same. Wherever Jenny is I hope she is happy! She was the best. I will try eating here again, but a little suspicious they kept the same phone number and even reviews. For Jenny's Thai: LOVE IT! The lady who runs the restaurant (still not sure if this is Jenny) is the nicest. I have become a regular, ordering once every couple of weeks and they have never once dissapointed, and with multiple specialized orders. Well priced, good sized portions. Pad Thai amazing, Yellow Curry AMAZING, Pad see eww excellent, Thai tea oh YES etc etc. Highly recommended!

Cashier was very rude to CUSTOMER picking up food. Order was for 6 dishes, extra condiments were requested, and rude response was given. " This is not a sushi restaurant." That was an unnecessary comment to make.
Your typical mom and pop shop, So nothing fancy. Food is tasty, but the portions are small. If you want a lot, the soups come larger portioned. Good for take out.

Everything I have tried is excellent. This is a lovely place to enjoy really good food for a great price. I especially love the icee drinks they have, they are excellent on a hot summer day. They are quick to serve you. The waitresses are super friendly and greet you with a smile. This really is a hidden gem, very very good!

This place is exceptional. My brother has not eaten for about 5 days and started to get an appetite, so this was one of his first meals. He and we all loved to food. Service was quick, polit, and professional. I recommend this place highly.

The orange chicken tastes like heaven. It’s Crispy . not overwhelmingly sweet or sour. It’s just perfect. No after taste as well. I’d come back for that. I had drunken noodles medium level and it was a bit more than medium but I enjoyed it.

The food is so yummy, it was great trying out this new place & Jayne (Jane?) was amazing she was so sweet and friendly when I came in to order, very accommodating and even brought me water while I waited. It’s so refreshing to go somewhere to order & you’re greeted so kindly with a very positive sweet attitude. Thank you Jayne!

The owners are very welcoming! The restaurant is very clean!!! And the food is very authentic which is what I look for personally. Me and my family have been eating at Spice up thai since their previous location. P.s. they only serve mango sticky rice seasonally, says a lot! Definitely recommend!!!

the food was very tasty however I asked for a 10 level for my spicy beef salad and honestly the spice level was probably no more than a two. The fried wontons had literally the thinnest slice of chicken to the point where I can almost see through the chicken but they were still tasty.the restaurant was able to bring back Justice with the delicious eggplant that was actually spicy, tasty, full of different flavors. I highly recommend getting that dish.

Jenny's Thai Resturant is absolutely amazing! The eatery is clean, well decorated, spacious, and comfortable. Jenny, along with her husband, not only prepare amazing cuisine that can satisfy your appetite day after day, but they offer genuine warmhearted hospitality every time and It's honestly what makes this restaurant a staple in the community.

I have been coming here for a while now due to it being the nearest thai food. Honestly, have enjoyed the food every time. Its never so busy that I can't get a seat which is always a treat, I've always hated to wait for food but that's never the case with this place. I order the usual; yellow curry chicken and steamed rice, sour and spicy soup and pad see yu noodles in beef, tastes SO GOOD! Never gets old. The place is always clean, the docorations are nothing to rave about but that's okay cause it's about the food and the hospitality anyway. The prices are not too bad in comparison to other places I've been. This place has become our little spot. I hope this place continues to be in business for many years to come, it really is underrated.

I love going to a place called Jenny's and finding out Jenny is actually cooking the stuff back there! That alone deserves a little attention. But the food would still stand well by itself if that cool bit never existed. I'm here once a month minimum. Spicy Beef Salad, ANY noodles, and egg noodle seafood soup. Make sure you visit, ordering on the phone isn't the best way to get this food :)

One of the best places in the valley to eat. Simple and plain. The food is amazing and the quality of their customer service is top-notch, very friendly people. They are very good with the pricing and they serve generous amounts of quality food with every order. I like their Pad See Ew & Tom Kha the best. They deserve more recognition

Me & my boyfriend been customers here for the past 6 years but apparently as of today we’re banned only because we didn’t pick up our food 1 time due to us being involved in a car crash. it was an emergency & they didn’t even give us the chance to explain ourselves, 6 years ! We’ve been coming here & because of this 1 time of us not being able to pick up our food we’ve been banned & if we did order the cook only agreeed if we payed an extra $60 on top of a $65 dollar order. Can u believe that ?!? $125 for some chow Meiji , rice , & orange chicken . They should be ashamed of themselves.

Good food & Reasonable prices. The Pad See Ewe was very flavorful but didn't have chinese broccoli (they used regular broccoli instead). The Chicken Satay was nice and peanut dipping sauce was 🔥 Recommend and will visit again

Jenny is the best! She humbly prepares delicious food. Her vegetable fried rice is the best! After trying many places, she delivers the most abundant helping of vegetables in her fried rice. As of June of 2022, their service is takeout only.

Amazing, authentic, and delicious! Spice Up Thai Eatery is a hidden little gem with wonderful, flavorful, and spicy food. If it's not spicy enough on its own they also have a tabletop wheel of spices to choose from to add that little extra zing! The owner was very kind and attentive. We had the crab Rangoon, Thai Basil Shrimp, Kung Pao Chicken, and Pad Thai shared among 3 people and it was more than enough food with lunch tomorrow as well! Highly recommend the Basil Shrimp and the Pad Thai, but all of the food was Amazing!
Very quiet and cozy place service was on point and the food was very fresh and lots of flavor and the price was very reasonable

After one visit, this is now my favorite Thai place. I had Spicy Chicken Noodle dish. The noodles were fresh, thick and spicy. The chicken was was fresh, soft and moist (not hard like others). Looking forward to my second visit!
Very good food, not too greasy like other Thai places I've visited. Friendly staff. Family owned place. Very clean. Food took a while to come out but it was fine because it wasn't made until ordered.

Enjoyed the small bowl of Seafood Tom Kha Kai Soup & it was delicious! Expressed curiosity regarding fresh spring rolls but none happening here. Perhaps if more customers requested them it might become an item? Until then it's all deep fried. Prices so good that it's easy to get TIPsy and pay the love forward. Atmosphere chill, service was inviting, prompt, and genuine.

Wow, I don't get 🙄 how this place ranked more stars? If the food were exceptional then I could justify the cost. It's a bit too pricey for what you get and I got 3 little skewers with thin strips of 🐔 chicken. Sorry, will not go there again.

Great food at decent prices. Took a chance on this local Thai eatery and was not disappointed. Favorites include the Tom Yoon Goung soup, Red Curry, and Mongolian beef. Parking around the spot is a little cramped but ample parking on the street and in shopping complex across the street.

I dont get tired of this place Jenny is the owner and she cooks as orders. Very fresh and delicious. Always order to go when we dont want to cokk over the weekend. It's a small bussiness for what you have to be patient and since everything is made as order it might take a good 20min to be made. Love the Pad Thai Chicken, combination fried rice, glass noodles soup (chicken) but it comes also with shrimp, chicken satay is delis with their peanut sauce and a side salad, also for the little ones the love their orange chicken and beef brocoli( as normal) You got to give it a try. We are regulars and the consistency in the food and service have been lithe same for the past 5yrs since we've been coming. Highly recommended.
They never disappoint! Food is sooo good! Not too greasy like some Thai places. Great friendly service. Its the only place we get carry out from. The best Thai food in town. We eat here a lot

Food was great and the customer service is the best I have experienced in a long time. The online system got one of my orders wrong. When I called to let them know, they did not hesitate to make things wright. Thank you for the amazing food and service.👍👍🙏🙏

TERRIBLE! I got the Pad See Ew with Beef and Shrimp My Gawd! Worst Pad See Ew I've had IN MY LIFE! Everything tasted old.. The noodles were dry and flavorless.. the beef was dry and chewy.. the 3 shrimp I paid an extra $2 for must have been old.. because it was Extra Fishy I just had Really good Pad 2 nights before, so I was excited to try it at another place... Boy do I regret that. I also got the "Dynamite" Chicken Wings There was surely nothing "Dynamite" about them! They taste like Yoshinoya's chicken wings, just as small, yet in a more watery spicier sauce. All around Epic Fail! This just goes to show You Can't Trust People's Reviews I could have went to at least 2 other nearby Thai places.. where I'm sure things couldn't have been any worse.. But this one had the highest rating. (face palm) Not to mention, I asked for chopsticks from the boy at the register, his reply was "I put two forks in the bag".. . Forks and Chopsticks are Apparently the Same Thing Everybody! You learn something new everyday! Also the ambiance is more that of a Pizza Parlor than what the pics would lead you to believe, not that it's a bad thing. I gave it a 1 in hopes to even out this stupidly high score of theirs, it was really more of a 2. It didn't appear dirty, in the front at least, and the order was done quickly. Largely cuz no one was there... $23 down the drain I won't be back

Were to start. The food was tasteless and the service bad . Even when ordering for take out they said wait was 20 min and they took 40 . There was 2 customers who came after me and they got there food first . While i was still waiting . Dont recomend it . Curry was bitter and taste less . Friend rice was more like white rice. Its up to you if ud like to waste your money here.
My favorite Thai Restaurant since 2005. Every plate is freshly prepared. The flavor is incomparable. The amount of ingredients in each plate is perfectly balanced.

Came in for some much needed Pad Thai, and I ordered it a la carte, only had about $8 and change on my person. So I order and take a seat, (place is completely empty mind you, not a bad thing AT ALL) and the gentleman pleasantly sets down a small cup of chicken soup, it is LITERALLY tickling the most elegant areas of my olfactory system, (aka my nasal passage ha ha)! This is a surprise to me, (rememeber me ordering a la carte?) and even more so when he brought a lunch special plate, chock full of delicious (and crunchy!) pot stickers, salad, a nice mound of rice and my Pad Thai...JACKPOT! I will DEFINITELY be back, not to expect another free lunch special, but because they were kind enough to offer, and the food was EXCELLENT.
Great food, but every time I call it’s a 30 minute wait and I end up waiting a extra 5 when theirs only 2 other customers here. Service is just fine. If u got the time its worth the wait

Love this place! Love the curries.. The yellow and panang are soo good and the Beef Pad See ew (sp?) is delicious. We live right across the street and order from here several times a month. Highly recommend.
Best Thai food I’ve ever had, I highly recommend the sea food soup and the orange chicken, they are simply amazing. The portions are very good for the price! A bargain!
Great food! Loved the green Curry I got the other day. Also loved the combo fried rice. I recommend getting the wontons with plum sauce
Very good Thai food. I like their spicy beef noodles. The service is very polite and helpful and the food is always fresh and prepared on the spot. I recommend to all Asian food lovers.

Has your standard Thai offerings (pad Thai, panang curry, prik king). What really elevates this humble spot in a strip mall is their tom kha soup, which is definitely one of the best versions I've had.
Got the Drunken Noodles with chicken, super delicious! A bounty of veggies, great tasting noodles, nice basil bits, and quality chicken. 10/10 would recommend
Nikki and Apple make the best Thai food. Haven't eaten anywhere else .
Delicious food, generous portions and relaxing atmosphere. Will visit again.
Nice clean and quiet place. The owners Jenny and her husband Pat are always very friendly. The food is excellent and good sized portions..not overly priced. I always come back for more.😃
Had the Spicy Fried Rice and Pad See Ew both were great! Quantity was enough for leftovers. Staff is very friendly and courteous.
The tom kha soup and spicy noodles were both amazing! I loved my panang as well! Great $9 lunch special.

Nothing else to say. 5 stars. Best thai food I've had in a long. long. long. time. Beats Lumkanaad outta the park. Had the spicy noodles, tom kha kai, and beef salad. Perfect heat and acidity. Gotta say it again. 5 stars
The food was really good and the server was very nice. The only thing I didnt like was the parking, which cant be fixed easy and the price. I felt like the food was just a tad bit too expensive

Unfortunately, the last time I went, I found not one but two black strands of hair in my takeout order (and my hair isn't black). The cooks do not wear hair nets apparently. Check your food before you eat it.

Great food, great service and the place is clean. My nephew loves the steamed dumplings and the chicken fried rice is to die for!
Great food for good prices and the owners are friendly. It's way better than Rincome down the street so definitely come here instead. 💯

Best Authentic Thai restaurant in Granada Hills. Support local restaurants such as this since there will be a time where thai food will be like the east coast and be bland with no spice.
My favorite place. I love the food and the service is excellent. My boyfriend and I are regulars here. I would definitely recommend.
Absolutely delicious. Had the crab Rangoon and orange chicken. Great price and great quality. Will definitely be back
Delicious authentic Thai food made with love! Great food, friendly staff, family owned - what more do you need to know?
Great place, great selection, great price, amazing service. The best Thai food place in the valley! Highly recommend it.
The best Thai food in the valley, hands down. Yellow curry, chickem pad thai, and coconut soup are my go-to's every time.
This food was absolutely amazing..me and my husband very much enjoyed the food and couldn't stop taking about it. Excellent prices and so worth it!
Food was awesome. Shrimp Pad Thai was great. Not dried out like others.
Satay chicken, papaya salad, and sticky rice were really good. You can dine in. Great customer service. Love it
Came in for dinner after work and it was the perfect meal to complete my night. Service was great! Food was excellent!
Absolutely Delicious, and very flavorful cuisine. One of my favorites is the Wonton Soup to start
Yellow curry and spicy noodles were a 10/10 and the staff is incredibly friendly! Portions are huge!
I super enjoyed coming here with my boyfriend. He was looking for a new Thai place to try and this place was amazing. Will be coming back.
Really good food, my uncle took me here by surprise and normally I do not like Thai food
The food is always great.
Large portions, generous with the iced tea ;) Ordered Orange chicken. Was *spicy*, but good. Enough for two people. 👍👍
Great delicious pad Thai at a fine establishment! Jenny is very welcoming and makes you feel at home.
The food is always fantastic, speacially the spicy shrimp soup #16. One of our favorite places to eat.
Food was delicious and went above and beyond to make sure we were happy with the order. Thank you

Always good food and good service, nice and clean, take out only at this time, so phone order.
Really good food. Their orange chicken and pad thai is bomb. Friendly service.
Okay food. It is a little oily. There are better options in the area, but in a pinch, this place will do. I wouldn't make it a destination.
Delish authentic food, great service and the owner, Apple is a sweetheart. Highly recomended
Delicious, fresh and authentic food at a great price, fast service, this place is a real gem!
Good spicy noodles and BBQ pork. The seafood soup was good too. Really thick noodles.
Great food!!! Most authentic I've had outside of Thailand.

Thai food family owned and run good local choice ! When busy they don't answer ! Closed Mondays !
Exceptional service. A lot of great things on the menu, but where this place really shines is the noodles 👍
The food was delicious and he staff was friendly. Definitely a place to keep going.
Not satisfied at all...portions were minimal for the price and taste did not surprise me.... will definitely not go back!!!
I love the food and the service. Very good price$ and quiet place to eat.👍
Everything was made fresh and so so good. One of my fav Thai spots
My favorite Thai food outside of Thailand. Excellent, authentic and delicious!
Great tasty place!! Wish the portions are larger than right now.
Love this place. The food is always excellent, and the service is always top notch

Great food, been here several times. Servive is good too

Food was delicious and they were very friendly and accommodating!
Great food great service. The food is the best and the prices are reason.
Love eating here , the orange chicken dinner combo is my addiction. I can’t seem to try anything else.
Good food, good prices, a little warm when you dine in, though.
Best pad Thai I've found in the valley hands down. highly recommend!
Good people ,the food is fantastic. Large portions.
