I have personally been a customer for over 7 years almost 8 . The food is always incredible . In store is very quiet , calm , clean & staff is friendly . You can order online the food is just as great . Unlike other Thai spots around !

I recently ordered the yellow curry with tofu online, and the process was incredibly straightforward. While I had high expectations for my meal, I found the vegetables undercooked and overly crunchy, especially the potatoes. Despite this, I appreciated the generous portion size.

I'm always in search of incredible Thai food and I stumbled upon this place and wasn't disappointed . It's a spot with a simple design, around 8 tables and with incredible aura. Something about the vibe made me feel so relaxed, so at home. A kind waiter brought the menu and told me about some of the favorites. I ended up going with Spicy Basil entree with chicken. The chicken was perfectly sautéed, had great savory flavor and was very tender. It was cooked together with basil, carrots slices, onions, green peppers and mushrooms. The brown sauce wasn't overpowering the ingredients. The flavors were well balanced and worked together in harmony for me to get that perfect bite. Honestly, it's one of the best Spicy Basil chicken dishes that I've had in LA. Will definitely come back to try more food!

Pad Thai is amazing! Yummy chopped up peanuts with bean sprouts and lime. I asked for medium spice and it was flavorful and perfect spice that I have been looking for. I called an order for pick up and it was ready when they said it would be.

I came here for lunch with my family after visiting our loved ones at the nearby cemetery. My late father's last dish was pad thai, so we wanted to honor his memory, and previous reviews for Spice Up Thai were promising. The ambiance was simple and clean, and we felt very comfortable during our stay. We had fried calamari and the lunch special, which comes with soup, rice, a salad, and fried dumplings. The fried calamari was freshly made and had a great crunch, and the dipping sauce had a nice little kick to it. I chose panang curry with tofu, my brother chose kung pao chicken, and my mother chose the mixed vegetables with chicken. My dish was delicious, and my mom and brother were also very pleased with their meals. The young man who served us was very nice, and service was prompt. Prices are more than reasonable, and the lunch special is, in my opinion, a great deal.

Was skeptical at first but the prices for the portions are very reasonable. Flavors were there and service was attentive and had your classic Thai Offerings like Tom Yum, Tom Kha, Pad Thai, and so much more. The combination fried rice was packed with flavor and had chicken, beef, and shrimp. Really good.

Had a hard time finding this gem but it was worth driving around for a bit until I found them. They have a free lot next door so keep your eyes peeled. We were welcomed and told to sit anywhere upon arrival. Tables were clean and well arranged. We had our order taken quickly and got our food pretty fast. The restroom key is needed for access which is a good sign. Our food was warm and well prepared. I thought it was delicious and almost felt homemade. Service was friendly and efficient. I would go back in a heartbeat. Thanks for a delicious and friendly experience. Portions are big. We had to take leftovers home.

I recently dined at Spice Up Thai and was thoroughly impressed by both the exquisite cuisine and the impeccable service. The menu showcased a variety of thai dishes, blending bold flavors and beautiful presentations. The attentive and knowledgeable server ensured that our meal was a memorable one, providing excellent recommendations and ensuring our satisfaction. Pad thai: 10/10 more than enough was served. Amazing flavors over all. Spicy Basil: 10/10 so many flavor in the thick both love the thai leaves as well. The dumplings for the appetizer and thai Thea to wash it all down. Everything was great I'd definitely recommend this spot!

This place always hits the spot. They're orange. Chicken is amazing and crispy. I live in the area and whenever I don't know what to eat I always come here and never disappointed. I hope more people come and eat here to enjoy their food. Really nice to have a hidden gem close by.
Some of the best Thai food I've tried in the U.S. - especially the Tom Yum noodle soup was incredibly flavorful with the right amount of acidity. Would come back again

Ahhhhhh jumping up and down with joy!!!! I am so happy this restaurant reopened. This is our go to spot for many years. The owner and cooks are so nice and very accomodating. We would come here weekly when they were located on Chatsworth and Balboa, they had closed down and they have now moved to Mission Hills. The food here is so good, I really enjoy the Tom Kha soup, the chow mein, roti curry, veggie fried rice, I mean they have so much to choose from. The restaurant is clean and we love coming here.
It's was so good. Thank you for keeping the food fresh and delicious. The service was good Quite and peaceful
The only failure here was I forgot to post photos of my amazing selection yellow curry and papaya salad was fabulous service top notch

I'm really happy that I found Spice Up Thai bc there food is pretty delicious Service is great, they're friendly & the music is pretty eclectic which is fun bc I was presently surprised at what was going to play next. My boyfriend & I have gone twice so far & we absolutely love their: - Orange chicken 5/5 - Pad see ew 5/5 - Tom yum soup 5/5 - Tom Kha 5/5 Yellow chicken curry w veggies 3/5 a little watery for me I thought we had gotten their fried wonton's before & my bf reminded me that we ordered them a diff time from a diff place after I had already ordered them 1/5 not enough stuffing for the amount of fried wonton there is

Walk in & no one is sitting down eating the music is blasting Notorious B.I.G. Walk up to the counter and out comes a man over worked and asked me what I want. Politely tell him I need another two minutes to view the menu. By the way he's also the only one answering phone and running back and forth to the kitchen. I ordered Pad See Ew and Steamed Chicken Dumplings. I have a seat and start noticing that this places is out dated and definitely needs some work. A woman appears from the back and shouts at the man to answer the phone. At first I thought maybe she doesn't speak English since I said hello to her and smiled while she put two drinks at my table I didn't order. She doesn't make eye contact and doesn't say anything back: extremely rude and made me feel awkward. Phone rings again and shouts out to him the phone is ringing and to call the customer back. dumplings 3/5 pad see ew: 3/5 I have been here 3 times and I've had the pad see ew 2 times and I still think they are below average on flavor. I once had the orange chicken and that's incredibly delicious and worth it. The dumplings didn't taste out of this world and I'd never recommend anyone to get them. You lost me as a customer. 06/21/24

Cute little restaurant, neat and clean. Service is fast and courteous but the food itself is mid-range. Authentic, but flavors are ok. I would recommend as a solid pick for a first time Thai experience. White Rice was a bit dry, costs extra We had Pad Thai, Pineapple Fried Rice, Nam ploy? Beef Salad(served with uncooked cabbage leaf quarter chunk) not really recommended), Chkn satay, Yellow Curry.
Each visit to this establishment impresses me with its exceptional food, carefully chosen music, and the young owner's dedication to every aspect of the dining experience. 10/10

Visited Spiced Up Thai tonight.....was craving Pad Thai......loved it. Also had their cucumber salad....crunchy and bright with red bell pepper & chopped red onion. The owner is very friendly and nice.. I suggest everyone go and try their Pad Thai

We ordered to go; the food was mediocre. For $70 it was not worth it, we ordered through Yelp and by the time Yelp informed it was ready to be picked up, my husband went and the staff had not even seen the order yet. This restaurant accepts orders by the time they open but do not adhere to customer service. Again, the food was okay.

Very solid pad thai! It's usually the first thing I get when trying a new thai place. My friend let me try the Tom kha soup and the broth was very tasty. I went during lunch time and only 1 persons was working the front. I'm surprised it wasn't busier. Would like like to try it again!

This is a super great find! Family owed. The food is very fresh, flavorful, delicious and reasonably priced with excellent size servings. I value this place so much I felt urged to write this review believing they so deserve all the support they can get. They are humble and work hard to serve fabulous home cooking.
I frequent this place for their Thai soup. It's full of flavor and the staff is very friendly.

Never get deceived by external appearance, how true this is and especially for this place. We were driving from LA to SFO and it was about time for lunch, we looked up for a thai food place nearby and we saw this place was not too far from freeway, so we added a stop. When we came near the restaurant, the place outside didnt look great but as usual I trusted yelp and went inside this place. The service is quick and we ordered grilled veggies and kung pao chicken. I ordered the iced coffee too. Except for the iced coffee which was way too sweet, everything else tasted so good. The veggies were cooked so well with their sauces and tasted delicious. The side of brown rice was also unique and tasted great. We were glad that we decided to stop here and try this place.
Such great authentic food in a small home style restaurant! Will definitely be back! If you're looking for a Thai spot in the valley this is definitely the place!

Small little hole in the wall in my neighborhood. Food is tasty and came out quick! Pad See Ew with beef 5/5 - well balanced flavor. Papaya salad 4.5/5 - got it in a medium but it's more mild otherwise super greasy and great taste! BBQ pork 5/5 - just the perfect amount of char, juicy and the lime chili dipping sauce is perfect.

I have to tell you I just love this place. I'm partial it's in my neighborhood and I like to support my neighbors. The food I think is great. The service is pretty good and the ambience is OK. It's my neighborhood Thai restaurant and I would go there any day.

We have been here a few times (throughout the years) and Also ordered delivery . We are just a few minutes away. Always so tasty and made to perfection. The drunken noodles are a must try . Panang Curry is my favorite and of course we can never forget the spicy fried rice. the staff is always super friendly . You need to stop by! P.S : Don't forget to order their Thai Tea!!!

We wanted so badly to like this place because it looked quaint (in the best way) and the menu looked amazing. However we tried THREE times to eat here and were turned away each time. We tried different weeks (within different months), different days of the week, and different times of day. Every single time we were told that they didn't have most of the menu available, so the most we could get was maybe one soup or a salad of some sort. We're tired of trying at this point and won't be making a fourth attempt.
First time here with my daughter and this place is amazing. The food is fresh and very tasty so glad to have found this place, will definitely be coming back.
Super flavorful food. I was really impressed by the soup -- coconut one -- and the curries. Pad se ew was also delicious.

I'm not a big Thai food person but this place has converted me. Their pad see ew and pad woo sen are scrumptious! Also liked their chicken satay. Prices are reasonable too. Only thing is, their AC is weak so it might be a little hot.
The best Thai food in the Valley. I drive about 5 miles and I bring all my friends and family here and they never disappoint.
First time eating here the food was amazing greatly recommended. The food was fresh and tasted amazing with all the right spices.

Happy to see our favorite Thai place opened up their doors again but this time at a new place. Thank you Spice up Thai for cooking our favorite plates Looks like you have alot of regulars. That's nice to see.

The Tom Yum soup and yellow curry chicken are delicious. But the Tom Yum soup is one of the best I have had, it is rich in taste and has a slightly unique taste. A one of a kind, hole in the wall spot.

I ordered their Tom Yum Kai and requested that they make mine soup with no spice at all. I have stomach issues that cause me to not be able to eat spicy food anymore. They did exactly what I requested and it was perfect! Everywhere else I have ordered from I ask for no spice and it still spicy. I will definitely be ordering my soup from here from now on. Thank you!

Very affordable and everything taste amazing!! Thank you for such authentic food! I give a minus star because they take forever to make your food so be prepared to wait whether its take out or in house.
The basil pork noodles and Thai tea! Love coming here even after they moved away from Granada Hills. Very underrated.

I was looking for a new thai spot to try for lunch and I ran across this place. Really enjoyed the beef pad see ew! Big portion. And the broccoli wasn't over cooked. Chili sauce on the side added the perfect amount of spice. Thai tea was also delicious. If you like sweet, you'll love it. Total meal came out to be around $15. Service was good and fast. They have a bunch of lunch specials too, which I'll likely try next time I stop by.

This restaurant was not that great. I ordered pad thai, it was blah, it was not that great. The only thing I liked before I ate there, is it was close to my house. Would not order from them again. I didnt eat in restaurant my order was to go. Vics Thai Food in North Hollywood I would suggest
Hands down the best Tom yum and fried rice you will possibly find. Service is always exceptional as well. Highly recommend if you've never tried the place.

Legit Thai place with one of the best beef fried rice. We ordered the pad sew with shrimp, basil chicken, egg rolls, chicken curry, and beef fried rice. The kitchen accidentally made broccoli chicken first and they brought it out as well. Everything was well flavored and perfectly cooked. Friendly service, we were the only ones dining in but as we enjoyed our meal a lot of people came in for pick up and they were consistently delivering food. Thai level spicy so make note. Real kick you in the face spicy. Parking is in a small shared lot and can be tough.

Great flavors! We ordered the Tom Kha Kai, Masaman and the Prik King. Every dish had a wonderful strong flavor! Perfect amount of spice as requested. But the amount of protein added was not up to par with the price point. Because of that it loses a star.

I thought of trying this place for lunch and wasn't disappointed. The young gentleman that works there was the most patient server I ever had. I stared at the menu for a very long time and couldn't decide what to order so he made some suggestions. I wasn't super hungry but hungry enough to eat small portion so I decided to try their orange chicken. Oh my goodness! It was one of the best tasting orange chicken I ever had! Crunchy on the outside and very moist on the inside. The salad was great too and dumplings tasted really good as well. I had my food prepared for to go since I knew I couldn't finish and ate the rest for dinner. Great customer service, great food and great price. Nicky was the one who waited on me and was so friendly and super patient with me. I can't wait wait to try other items on their menu. Also, I got Thai ice tea which was really good too and not watered down like other places that put too much ice in it. Highly recommend this place
I have gotten dinner about a half dozen times. I really love the coconut soup with noodles. The staff is always friendly and food is always nice and hot!

BEST THAI FOOD! So happy to have them back! They used to be located on balboa and recently took over another Thai Restaurant. If you live in the area run don't walk to try this gem. The Pad see ew is amazing!! Another two of my favorites are the prik king and Panang curry.

This has been my go-to Thai spot for YEARS! Such a hidden gem and we'll worth every penny. Their food is fresh and always with just enough heat. I get the pad see ew with beef and sometimes mix it up and get it with chicken (both options are EPIC!) Also, the owner got me addicted to Thai Tea which I had for thr first time at this place and is now a must have every single time I stop in. Definitely give this place a chance and spread the word, they deserve the love!

The food is delectable! Great depth of flavor. We ordered two dishes and enjoyed both. The yellow chicken curry was creamy with a sweet but balanced coconut flavor. I asked for mild spice which was perfect (cannot handle too spicy). The shrimp pad woon was also a winner! The thin noodles were packed with so much flavor. It came with a scrambled egg, carrots, green onions, mushrooms, tomatoes, bean sprouts, bell peppers, celery, some cabbage bits and topped with cilantro. To sum it up, I will go back and definitely get these two dishes again. I think it may be my new favorite Thai spot. The only suggestion is if you are not a patient person, then call it in ahead of time to pick up. It took 30 mins to pick these items up for phone order. I had no issue with waiting but maybe for some people short on time- I suggest to plan ahead.

Wish I would have taken pictures . Sorry I was starving, had a long drive just got back from Culver City . Getting back home to the valley, I came across this amazing Thai restaurant. I ordered egg rolls as an appetizer and red curry with shrimp as my entrée. Let me tell you , it was all delicious and delightful . The flavor , the quality and the taste . Don't miss out on this jewel of a place . The staff is so polite and accommodating. The ambience is chill and calm. Will definitely be back . Thank you Spice Up Thai Eatery .

We were craving for Thai food. The restaurant is located in a tiny plaza with a 711 store. The food portions were pretty generous. The spicy beef salad had the solid flavors of salty & ample acid. Nonetheless, the beef was a bit tough to chew. Hubby liked the pad see ew. The chicken pad thai was decent.
Some of the best Pad Thai, Drunken Noodles, and Panang Curry! Great staff and very reasonably priced.
Man this place is great , the curry is ridiculously delicious , I recommend you eat there but it still taste amazing when you do takeout ..... don't sleep on the pad Thai
Best Thai food in the North Valley. Soups are fantastic. Regular is really spicy, so go easy.

New location next to Papa John's. Glad they're back, this is the only Thai place we like in the Valley. Came in for a weekday lunch and got Panang Curry lunch special $11 comes with curry, soup, salad, rice and dumpling. You can never go wrong with Pad see ew. Different location, same great tasting food!
Excellent lunch special tofu yellow curry I even ordered food for later that night to take away

It's a small place I walked in. There was a couple there waiting for food when I paid for my food. The lady at the desk it said oh pre-king is my favorite. I said it's mine too. I brought it home. It is so delicious. I asked a couple in that restaurant if they have been here before and they said we are returning customers it is so tasty here I believe it the curry I had today was delicious and the pad breaking was also very good. Thank you.

The best thai food restaurant in town. The owners are very welcoming. My family has been coming here for 7 years (even at their old location). My husband loves their coconut soup, and I enjoy the orange chicken and pad see-U. The restaurant is clean and my daughter loves coming here too!

My Wife and I found this little gem on doordash a few years ago and have been going once a month ever since. Hands down the best shrimp fried rice and tom yum noodle soup you will possibly find in the valley and quite possibly all of LA area. The tom yum and fried rice is soooooo flavorful, i've never had a bad visit. Their food is so consistent. The staff is also super friendly and attentive. Highly recommend if you're ever in the area.
This place has one of the best orange chicken you can find. It's crispy and delicious. No after taste. No over whelming sweetness. Just perfect. I also had drunken noodles. I enjoyed it great

I think they kept the last cook from when it was Thai Basil, because the food is amazing. Some of the best Thai food I've had in a long while. FYI- their Medium spice level is slightly on the spicier side of med. same fr when it was Thai Basil. Unless you prefer your food to be on the spicier side, I'd rec you order one dish med and one dish mild or no spice. Ex. Med- eggplant entree + no spice - pad see ew. It will help balance out your palate Ordered the following and it was perfect for 2 plus leftover for the next day. 1) med spicy- Eggplant w chicken 2) no spicy- pad see ew w beef 3) med spice - spicy beef salad (next time I'd get mild spice, the heat was strong because it's salad) 4) mild - garlic green beans w chicken 5) small rice Total: $44 This place will be my go to Thai in the valley!! Be got some back ups, but this place is legit!
Cool local spot around the corner from our place. Nice staff and super good deals and large portions. Will totally be back especially for the lunch special
The Tom Yum Shrimp is the best. Nicky the owner is very friendly and always provided the best service.
Very small place, the sup was awesome, I definitely recommend. l really like the soup and the rice.

The food is so yummy, it was great trying out this new place by our house. Jayne (Jane?) was amazing she was so sweet and friendly when I came in to order, very accommodating and even brought me water while I waited. It's so refreshing to go somewhere to order & you're greeted so kindly with a very positive sweet attitude. Thank you Jayne!

I was craving Chinese/Thai food. This restaurant was the closest. We got in, it was nothing fancy but let me tell you the food was really good. We got seafood soup we finished so fast I didn't take a picture. Chow mein was so good I liked the smokiness. Broccoli beef was regular. If you want good food, you don't care defensiveness of a restaurant this is a place to be.

First time! Love the free delivery within 3 miles option, even though I came in this time. No one was in the restaurant so service was super fast. I ordered shrimp rad nah and the egg rolls. The egg rolls looked like lumpia. They're skinny and super deliciously crunchy. Veggie filled. There were like 8 mini egg rolls in the order. I love these, I could probably eat 2 orders. The rad nah had a really strong toasty flavor. Good but stronger than I'm used to. Adding shrimp was $5 extra on a $9 dish. Most other meat or tofu is a $2 charge. I think there were 5 shrimp in the whole dish. I don't know if that's work $14 dollars but the food was still good. Nice to have a fast Thai place down the street, l definitely be back.

Really good lunch specials... I tried the Mongolian beef, it had good flavor with a lot of fresh garlic which I loved.. next time I will be trying the beef basil... the place is nice and neat, the service is fast and the prices are great.. my lunch special included two small pot stickers, white rice, a delicious simple salad and the Mongolian beef for 12.00. I will definitely come back and try other items in the menu.
Trying it for the second time today because the first time was delicious! What a little gem in the neighborhood. Will make it one of our top choices moving forward.

5 stars for their $8 LUNCH SPECIAL! I got the SPICY BASIL. For $8 you get a hearty soup of mushrooms, chicken and lemongrass, main dish, rice (I got brown rice which was $.50 extra), egg roll, and salad. I ordered mine with mild spice and it was perfect. Portion was great in that it wasn't too filling and they gave enough vegetables and shrimp (shrimp was $2 extra but I had a coupon for $2 off). I ate it all feeling perfectly full minus the feeling of food coma. The Spicy basil sauce was nice and savory with a good balanced kick. Egg roll was nice and crispy without the oiliness. Salad was okay-I'd rather have romaine over iceberg lettuce though. It's located in a plaza so there's ample parking. Lunch special is from 12-3pm I believe.

My friend Arthur keep taking me to this place and it is the best. He introduced me to me to the Tom yum shrimp soup and now I am addicted to it. The owner Nicky is very nice and provides excellent service.

Really good Thai restaurant situated in the corner of a commercial complex. The food was really good and the customer service was awesome! The actual restaurant was somewhat clean. The food came out pretty quick and were served in decent/big sized portions. I really like their chicken pad sew ew and yellow Thai curry. A definite hole in the wall!

This is like mom and pop restaurant. Everytime I go here, it has been the same guy who serves, which is nice, so you build that relationship to that restaurant itself. Located by the intersection at the small plaza. The restaurant was not very easy to spot, nearby the pizza place. Place is small but not too small. Food comes in a decent time. I had Crab fried rice which is my favorite, I always get this everytime I got here, the flavor is just perfect. I also had the drunken noodles. Interestingly, I am not into their pad thai. Service is good. I will keep coming back and would love to try more food on the menu but I am hooked with the crab fried rice =D
Great authentic Thai flavors. Great service, affordable prices. My favorite dish is pad ka prow with extra basil. Must try. Sorry, it looked so good, I didn't take a picture of it.
Great Thai food, super service Nice that it's a local hole in the wall mom and pop restaurant. Supporting small business
Food was flavorful and tasty. We had the Combo fried rice, noodles & garlic chicken. We will be back!

Tom yum soup was too sweet. Chicken skewers were very dry and meat was tough. Fried rice was nice. I wanted to try a different place but i dont think j will be a repeat customer. I know for the $$ there are better options out there. Nice staff poor food.
grrrrreat food! get the combination fried rice, its the bomb cant recommend enough do it do it do it

3 stars at best. We ordered delivery a few weeks back and I wasn't thrilled with our food The Pad Thai was clumped together and the flavors were off as well Food was not hot when it was delivered but it was on time Not sure if I recommend going here or not

This is a very good Thai restaurant. We ordered orange chicken, chicken pad see ew, Mongolian beef and cheese wontons. Not greasy or oily. Really good chicken and beef. If looking for a better Thai/Chinese place in the valley this is it. Highly recommended.
Food was on point. Delicious fried tofu red curry, orange chicken was so crunchy and delicious . Squid salad amazing!!! Definitely coming back!!!!

Small hole in the wall Thai Food in a sketch shopping center! My kind of place!!! My wife and I had their egg fried rice and it was simple and delicious. Next was their pad thai. noodles are skinnier than the typical flat pad thai noodles but it made no difference - this dish was also very tasty! one of the better pad thai that we've had. We will be back!
Delicious food! I will be ordering from here again. Fast service. I highly recommend you give this place a try. I'm new to trying Thai food and this place was awesome.

I just came here for my first time ! Ahhhh I can't describe how good it was, it was authentic and they serve so much ! I recommend it to anyone in the valley, I got there shrimp fried rice with only egg and onion. The food and the service was awesome. The guy cashiering was really nice and so was the lady who came out to give me my sauce and food. Thank you for the experience and the food. I will be coming back. Worth it. PS they put foil to keep it hot ! Genius
Delicious Thai food and good service. Family owned restaurant with a home cooked feel. Never disappointed

Everything we ordered was delicious and we were very impressed with the quality and presentation of the food. They have some really skilled chefs in the kitchen! The only thing that I didn't love was the Thai iced tea - it is very sweet but otherwise what you'd expect. Very generous sized cup, which was a nice surprise. Our server was very patient and kind. Not super attentive but definitely a nice guy and ready to help. Easily the best Thai restaurant I have been to in the valley and would happily go back.

Friendly, service, great food you have to come here.. If you don't like thanks Sweet asked for the food without sugar. They are very, accommodating to vegetarians and vegans. Had mixed vegetables and the Coconut lemongrass soup soup absolutely amazing! My friend had the shrimp glass noodle salad she loved it and she also had crab Rangoon said those were out of this world!

It was A-Ok. I kept trying to grab the taste of Thai spices and it was just not kicking for me. Spices needed to be elevated more. I ordered the sweet and sour pork and shrimp pad thai noodles. The meat was not the best -- small chunks of meat that were chewy and no real flavor (more sour than sweet -- not even balance). The Pad Thai Noodles taste the same and I kept adding sweet and sour sauce and another sauce but it wasn't working. The wontons were hard, dry and tasteless. The salad was the best -- very fresh and I loved the dressing. I just felt like I wasted calories. I waited a cool 35 mins for my food but the ambience was nice, relaxing and it is a cool spot. I'll give them benefit of the doubt based on their four stars that maybe it was just a rough night in the kitchen or I should have tried one of the signature dishes. I'll give them another try in the future. Happy Yelping #SYOY

I really wanted to like this place but it's a solid Meh, from me. Not horrible but not great either. I ordered from Door Dash and had a few issues with the food. I ordered Cashew Nut Chicken, Tofu Pad See Ew, Vegetable Pad Thai and a side of brown rice. I usually prefer Beef Pad See Ew but for some weird reason, you can't order beef on any of the dishes when ordered through Door Dash. The Pros: -The serving sizes compared to the price is an absolute steal. You get huge portions for cheap. -The food arrived quickly and hot. -It was packaged great and didn't spill or make a mess. -The Cashew Nut Chicken was good and the only thing I have a complaint about is it was not at all spicy even though that's what I asked for. The Cons: -My Pad Thai didn't come with Pad Thai Noodles. Usually the noodles are flat rice noodles and what I got was skinny, round rice noodles similar to Spaghetti noodles. The tasted the same but it was odd. -The Pad Thai was a dark brown and was even darker than my Pad See Ew. Pad Thai is supposed to be a light brown or light orange shade. This makes me think they probably use the same pan for all of the noodle dishes and don't clean it in between. It didn't taste burnt but didn't taste like fresh Pad Thai and look really unappealing. -The Pad See Ew was good but doesn't have the most flavor, it was a little bland. Overall though I did prefer it over the Pad Thai. I hate leaving bad reviews and if you check my history you'll see that I literally never do but I don't think I would order from here again. It doesn't seem like it's the freshest. I usually spend $50-$70 on this exact order for half the portion size at my other Thai spots; But I would honestly rather spend more for less if it's fresher than getting this huge portion. Quality over quantity in my opinion.

Inauthentic. Not very good I'm sad to say. * Pad Thai - Bland, overcooked noodles. Overcooked chicken. * Papaya Salad - Also bland. Dressing is missing the citrus. Beef Salad - Underseasoned. Also missing citrus. Fried Tofu - The one good thing we got. Well fried and good sauce. We won't be ordering again.

We ordered delivery for the second time. The food was fantastic aga!! I've tried many different Thai restaurants in the last year since we moved to Northridge and so glad we found this spot in Granada Hills!! The flavor is on point!! So many other places are hit and miss!! Everything we ordered is excellent! Beef spicy noodles (aka drunken noodles), shrimp pad woon sen, shrimp & tofu green curry extra eggplant, tom kha seafood soup & shrimp pad see ew. Shrimp, fish and excetera were all fresh!! Next time we will dine in!! This will be our to go place for Thai!! The guy that took our order was nice! Delivery was fast and on time for a large order! Give them a try... you won't be disappointed!!

2nd time tried it! Quick order and easy pick up for take out. Very small parking lot in small plaza. I had fried wonton, Tom Khan Soup & Spicy Noodle. Really good and perfect for shareable! Also had a Thai tea, but its too sweet for me, so I had to had water myself to less the sweetness. Overall, its really good and affordable for meals!
Absolutely scrumptious Thai Curries. Me an baebae came here to get our crunch on and we absolutely loved it! Thanks for the spice al cien ciaooooo

So happy to see they are open again. We got food last night and it was soo good! The same great food as before and the same great owners. I prefer the new location. Better parking lot and shopping center. No more random homeless people walking around.

I ordered the spicy beef salad and it was pretty good but I'm giving it 3 stars because half the salad was made with mostly onions. Look at picture. I was going to let this slide but the guy at the counter was rude when I asked for a fork claiming that it was already in the bag and it was NOT even in the bag so he gave me attitude for nothing and it prompted me to write this review.

Very clean establishment friendly staff the food I have ordered even trying something different every time I go is delicious. I appreciate that you don't have to ask for condiments unless for something extra. This is my favorite Thai place in town and I recommend anyone to go try it at least once while in the area.
Ordered pad Thai and the noodles were the wrong ones. They were like the skinny spaghetti and it was over cooked. Barely had any sauce. It was a gross mess

This place is very good. Already been coming here 4 times and everything has been good so far, great service and delicious food. We have yet to try their soups so that is next on our list. Thank you Spice Up Thai

This is a SUPERB Thai food place!!!! Their THAI ICED TEAS ARE TO DIE FOR! Food is ready super quick! I'm amazed at how fast the food came out after we ordered. The lighting in here is also romantic once it hits the evening time. Perfect for date night!!!!!

Three stars means A-OK and Spice Up Thai Eatery was definitely A-OK. I had been meaning to order from here for a while but just recently got around to doing so. I only ordered Pad Thai, which is my go-to dish for Thai restaurants. Theirs was perfectly adequate and I enjoyed it, but I have had much better (also much worse, so keep that in mind). I asked for and received a side of Thai peanut sauce which was not to my liking. I would guess that it was too vinegary but not being a Thai food expert, I'm not sure if that was the actual problem. I would avoid that on any future visit. Close enough to be convenient, I will probably return.

!!!!BEST Thai food in the SFV!!!!! Love the food. Ask for Apple, she's the best of the best. I've had a variety of their dishes from almost each category & I've never been disappointed. I also had them cater an event & everyone loved it. Below is what I've tried. Everything has been delicious & portions are very generous. Whenever possible, I order my food medium-spicy(love spicy food) & ask for their assortment of chilies on the side. If you aren't into spicy, order as is. DRINKS: Thai Iced Tea (with & without boba) APPETIZERS: Fried Tofu Fried Wontons Dynamite Wings Crab Rangoon(Wontons stuffed with crab & cream cheese) SALAD: Spicy Beef Salad SOUPS: Glass Noodle Tom Yum Soup Tom Kha Soup NOODLE SOUP: Tom Yum noodle Tom Kha noodle PAN FRIED NOODLES: Pad Thai Pad See Ew Spicy Noodle Chicken Noodle CURRY: Yellow Pineapple FRIED RICE: Pineapple Crab Shrimp MAIN DISHES: Spicy Eggplant Mongolian Beef Kung Pao Chicken Orange Chicken(the best ever) DESSERT: Sweet Sticky Rice with Mango Coconut ice cream

Cute little Thai restaurant that is worth trying if you are around the area. The shopping center that it is located in can be a little difficult to find parking. Try parking in the shopping center adjacent where the Walgreens is located. Prices are reasonable and portions are generous. They also have lunch specials and various dinner specials. I usually get their pad thai and it is very tasty. The staff is friendly and have provided us with additional food and drinks when the wait for the food was too long. Will definitely come back.
Orange chicken simply not good. Chewy dark meet chicken that was questionable. Not quality. Panang curry was just red sauce that was spicy. No real curry flavor. Would not order again.

If I could give this place 0 stars I would. Horrible place the kid working there yells at you when they have messed up your order and they are not willing to fix it. They have not customer service whatsoever that's why they are always empty.
Yum! My husband and I ordered the Combination fried rice and Beef Pad See Ew and it was delicious! Best Thai I have had in a long time. Definitely will be back to try more dishes!
Very good tom kha soup and pad see ew And owners are really nice And their calamari so good

This restaurant have a good food but bad customer service the man who took the order at the counter was rude and complained about us because it was hot and they don't turn on the air conditioning in the restaurant even when we asked

This place place is absolutely delicious. Our family orders from this restaurant quite often and we are never disappointed. You can absolutely tell this establishment cares about the quality of their food. My kids, who are very picky eaters, love the food from this restaurant. I highly recommend everyone try this Thai restaurant. If I can give it more stars I would. Enjoy!
Good food, big portions and customer service I had leftovers for lunch and they still tasted amazing
Food is always amazing and so is the Thai Tea. Service is always friendly and prompt. I would recommend them all day long!
Good food, nice size portions. Old and bland decor but very roomy inside. Staff is very friendly .The parking sucks here also. Very tiny lot.
Spice up Thai has some of the best Thai food in the valley. Nikki and Apple are totally adorable. Great customer service great food. If you love Thai food, you must eat at Spice Up Thai.
Local spot- our go to Thai fix! Food is always flavorful, hot and fresh. Go-to's- Papaya salad Coconut ginger soup w/tofu Pad Thai w/ chicken or shrimp Pineapple fried rice Pad See Ew w/ tofu

Ordered through Yelp and my order came quicker than I expected but they did not care to read instructions on my order. They got all of it wrong. Ordered the Pad Thai and asked for no eggs. My food was filled with eggs. Ordered the Tom Kha Noodle soup and no noodles, just the soup. Asked to substitute fish sauce on any of the dish that contained it to soy sauce. They probably didn't do that either. I'm Vegan so I avoid any animal products in my food. Someone reviewed that they're able to make things Vegan so I gave it a try. Never again! Thought I could trust this place, but I was wrong. It's what I get for being lazy I guess. I'm not feeling too well so had I wanted delivery..
Amazing food and good customer service. Nam tok beef salad was the best!! I'll be back soon!
Every time I come here I'm greeted and treated very nice Place always looks clean and taking care of. The food here is simply amazing. You can tell that it was prepared and cooked very well.

I have been here maybe three times now. The first time I placed a large order online and picked it up on my way home. I'm not sure if it was made right away and was sitting for awhile before I picked it up, but once I got home and ate, it did not taste good. I live only 3 minutes away so it couldn't have been the drive between the two. After this I swore I wouldn't eat here again. The second time I ate here was because my cousin was shocked that my first experience was anything but great. She eats here constantly and assured me that I would enjoy it. So we met up for lunch and ate in the restaurant. This time was WAY better than my first experience. The third time was right before going to the movie theater. I was with some family and friends. We got seated right away and our orders were taken quickly. The older lady came out and was talking to us, which made the whole experience so much better. The food exceeded my expectations this time. I will definitely be back. The only reason for not giving them 5 stars is the inconsistency. I'm sure I will update after a few more visits.

I love the pad Thai! I got the lunch special, and with it you get: egg roll, salad, rice, and soup along with your choice of entree! I wasn't a huge fan of the soup, it was too gingery/ lemony for me. However the pad Thai was great! It's was flavorful and did not feel greasy at all. The pad Thai was a bit smaller than I expected, but for the price and everything you get with it, it was a STEAL! The place is on the smaller size and is very quiet. The staff is friendly and nice! Will be coming back again
SPICE UP THAI EATERY IS THE MOST GENUINE AND FRIENDLY ONE. We order food for friends and family they make it less salt of spicy as needed. Always love their service . Thank you Blessings

Simply amazing Thai food in the area!! The spice and flavor are so on point I got the spicy noodles with chicken and spicy chicken wings. I would highly recommend this place if you love spicy food. The new owner took over and change the name and food quality.

. Honestly not bad but not great either the food taste is very strong not like the other Thai places that are more mellow and easy coconut flavors and instead they are heavy on the spices. The soup is super salty but the rolls are very fresh. The potatoes And the curry were not cooked at all and was very crunchy and the chicken instead was very overcooked. The green bean garlic was super oily. But the tile man was very good.The service is OK all in all not disappointing but not excellent either . Staff are very friendly
Good Thai food (and some Chinese dishes) at reasonable prices. We've had the spicy basil, the coconut soup, pad see ew, pad kee mao, orange chicken. All we're really good.
Unexpected delicious hole in the wall. We always order their tom yum seafood, Thai fried rice, and beef jerky!

I've eaten in here once and have gotten delivery from here plenty of times. The food is delicious and they don't shy away from the spice, as you would expect from the restaurant name. My only complaint is that the food portions are a bit small. To be satisfied, if you didn't order a fried noodle or fried rice dish, you need to order at least a main dish and a side of rice. As disappointed as I am by the portions and annoyed that they charge you for rice, they are still my favorite delivery Thai place. I don't like them enough to eat in here though. The place is clean but small, with a slightly fast food feel. It's fine for lunch but not a place to take a date.

This place was pretty good! I ordered the typical chicken Pad Thai and beef Pad See Ew dishes plus tried the Orange Chicken. Food: The portion size was awesome. For about $10 for each noodle, I felt I got my money's worth. The Pad Thai has really good flavors - no complaints. FYI - they use the thin pho noodles. As for the Pad See Ew, I wasn't a fan because of the flavors. They add finely ground pepper (maybe white pepper) which gives it a kick but it was too overpowering. There was also an unidentifiable taste/smell that reminded me of bamboo shoots, but there weren't any bamboo. The Orange Chicken was really crunchy and delicious. I ordered this to go and I needed to roll the window down because the vinegar smell was extremely strong. The sauce is super flavorful too, which is perfect to pair with rice. I probably wouldn't order this dish again only for health reasons. They are able to get the chicken crunchy because it's deep fried until it's almost burnt. Parking: Not great. It's a tight corner lot shared with other businesses including 7eleven. I went to pick up during non-rush hour and the lot was full. Overall: Good Thai food and portion size, would go back if in area.
This place has amazing food and customer service. They have a great variety of food to choose from.

I ordered delivery yesterday and received excellent food, fast delivery. There was an issue with the order, and it was rectified immediately. I love this place, and appreciate the warm attitude, fast service, delicious food. Thank you. This is my fourth year loving your restaurant.

Went in today, the menu changed and they no longer have the garlic pepper chicken. The guy working was a total jerk and claimed he has never had that dish!!! And then claimed the menu hasn't changed in two years!!! If you look at allllll the pictures of the yellowish menu its on there!! We will no longer be coming here!!

Great job Apple! This is a hole in a wall but filled with lots of spices and flavor! True to the taste of Thai cuisine. Parking is tough in this corner complex (Chatsworth/Balboa) next to 7-11 but worth the trip. Perfect size menu options and each dish is definitely made with care. If you don't like spicy food even if it's mild, this is not for you. Probably best to eat here in person based on delivery experience comments in other reviews. This is definitely up in my local restaurants to frequent!

After a 45minute wait, my soup finally came. Problem is the rice i ordered with it didnt, nor did the Thai iced tea I ordered, as a matter of fact not even a spoon. So now I'm sitting here staring at this pot with nothing to do! I'm so disappointed. FYI- the 5 stars are given by everyone is because they offer free appetizer with Yelp Review!!

Back today and it's been too long. Trying to shake a cold and was craving soup. Soup was well balanced and perfectly seasoned. Not too salty or sweet and just the right amount of heat for me. Hot tea was also offered after I mentioned that I had a cold and it too mad me feel better and was delicious. Finished up with mango sticky rice all very good. Hope to be back soon
Great food! Best Thai food restaurant that we have found. The food is actually spicy and flavorful.

By far the best Thai food I have EVER HAD!!! I've had a lot of Thai food. I've been to LA, Valencia, Antelope Valley, West Valley and I've never had such delicious Thai. I've had good Thai but not to make me say "it's the best I've ever had!" I got the spicy noodles with chicken and Thai tea. Both times I got the same thing and both times it was phenomenal. This is definitely going to be my Thai spot!! Love it.
Excellent Thai food with awesome service! The food is always delicious and generous portions!
This is our local thai spot for easy delivery. The guy that answers the phone is always nice, quick, and efficient. Our food usually arrives within 20 minutes. It's hot, fresh, and tasty.

Have to admit this was a back up location since the place we planned to eat was closed for the day. What a great find! The food is incredible. Made fresh And the hospitality is also great. We had a dinner special and another entree. I work in Chatsworth and found a new lunch place

What a gem in Granada Hills! I just found my go-to Thai Food restaurant. Literally down the street from my house so it's pretty convenient for me to get here. They have awesome service! The owner (Apple) came up to me and personally welcomed me - super sweet. Super nice cuz I came in by myself since I'm sick. She is so friendly! I figured some Tom Yum Noodle Soup with Shrimp will help my cough and congestion. I'm certain that this soup is the best Tom yum I've had... best with noodles. Seriously get it with noodles- you'll love it. Soft and perfect. I'm a noodles kinda gal though- but it gives a good texture to it. Thai tea is delicious- I'm pretty picky about Thai Tea and this was so good. Seating: Come in and they greet you. If there is enough room they will let you choose your seat. Best time to go is for lunch- they have a good deal on their lunch specials. I just missed it- its 11:00- 3:00 pm... but they're delicious. Parking: they have a private lot in front. Located by the 7eleven. Might have a tough time but There's always FREE street parking available. Ambiance: casual more like home feeling. It's simple- I like it. They have beautiful light fixtures. Random but they're so unique. TIP: CHECK IN and let them know how you feel about your experience on yelp. They thank you with free Thai Tea, Egg Rolls,or Gyoza.

Don't know what happened tonight, but our food was not very good. We usually love the dishes here but this time.....No flavor, flat sauce, tons of undercooked onions. Almost like Chinese food but plain. Maybe the regular chef couldn't make it. Maybe we'll try again but after 50+ $s, I expected better.
It was fine . I was not able to pick the spicy level on the curry and it was way to spicy for me. The glass noodles was ok.

I was excited to try out this place but was very disappointed in the food. We ordered fried wonton with chicken as an appetizer, There was barely any chicken in it and the taste of the chicken was off. We also ordered green curry soup with veggies and with brown rice. The waiter forgot to mention that ordering brown rice is extra $2. Besides that the curry had old cabbage in there which had black color around the corners of it.it was very disappointing because the curry tasted old. Please use fresh ingredients! Service was good The place was clean Thai tea was good! The food didn't taste good

It was just amazing! First time at this place. We ordered Wonton soup and Fried rice. We didn't expect the way how nice they'll serve the soup. So we shared the meal. Everything was super delicious. Inside was nice and clean too. They do have lunch specials but we didn't try it. I believe our check was $20 for two meals. Recommend this place.
Ewe !!!!!!! Food wasn't so great !!!!! Service was good.... food upset my Taste buds Most like won't come back

MY FAVORITE THAI FOOD EVER. Amazing flavors, must have - pad see ew, shrimp tom yum, orange chicken, and honestly the most flavorful shrimp fried rice I've ever had! I love everything about this small restaurant, the owner is very kind the food is always fresh and delicious. The only problem here is the parking!! Good luck finding a spot!

I've been coming here for YEARS with my family even the one before this location . ABSOLUTELY just fantastic , quality , authentic Thai food ! Above and beyond customer service always ! Makes you feel like family and always accommodating in every way to make the customer feel welcomed and taken care of ! Food is so delicious and seasoning is just right ! Recommendations : All the soups Chicken and shrimp fried rice Thai ice tea Egg rolls Satay chicken Honestly the whole menu !

Great food and the service is fast! My wife and our friend went here for lunch today. We have the crab fried rice, chicken salad, crying tiger and soup medium spice. I will be back to order for myself and I will get that heat...LOL! Everything was good! I appreciate that our waiter didn't rush us to order and when we did the food came out quick. We will be back soon!
It was my first time here, and the food and service was great :) There is a lot to choose from on their menu.

This place has a good customer service and good food quality! I was late for more than 30 mins picking up my order but the guy on the front insisted that he will make me another one since the noodles from pad thai and pad see eww are both soggy and not good anymore. He was very nice even if it was my fault picking up the food! If youre craving thai food in the valley area drop by here and you will not get disappointed! GOOD FOOD AND GREAT CUSTOMER SERVICE!!

It was our first time there! Let me start by saying the guy at the register was by nice or At lease not rude but not a good sever never asked if we needed anything, I had to call him from the back for mor water. We ate there and the places is really hot no AC. Moving on to the Food, yellow curry was good but too many veggies and not enough meet!! Same with the King Pau chicken, flavor is good but too much of everything and not enough meat, We also got the Tom Yum seafood soup and that was okay, not bad but not the best!!

The pad Woon Sen full of oil, very dark. Veggies not so good. The chicken is just like leather, very dry.. the Thai tea is pretty good the price is good..I found it to be extremely sweet. The food wasn't as good as it was before at the old location.
Excellent shrimp pad Thai and the mango & sticky rice (when in season ) is delicious.
Very goood! Foods great and tasty and very good portions! I would recommend this place over any near by thai place

My partner and I have seen this little spot pop up on our feed a lot since we are in the San Fernando area and it was an awesome stop! We ordered the calamari, which was a little spicy so if you can't handle that avoid it but we love ourselves some spice and the dipping sauce for it was nice and sweet. We also ordered the yellow curry and orange chicken, which were great as well. The yellow curry does not come with rice, but we were planning on getting some on the side anyway. We ordered the mild level spice for the curry and it was pleasantly spicy as well, but if you're going solo on it the spice does catch up with you about halfway through the bowl. The orange chicken was awesome, it was crunchy and sweet but the meat was tender, hot and the serving for it was a good plate full but it is a la carte so keep that in mind as well. The service was good, nothing crazy since it's a small shop so if you're expecting to come in and for them to table touch often it's not that style of restaurant. All in all i would probably order out from here more than anything but if you want a nice little quiet spot to have some delicious Thai food this is a good place to stop in some time :)
OMG... Spice up brought flavor and spice to perfection ! We ordered Tom Yum soup and vegetable egg rolls. Egg rolls were ok, but the soup was incredible!!!

I can't believe I haven't reviewed this place yet. THE BEST TOM KHA SOUP EVER!!! I am so glad that covid didn't shut this place down. They kept on delivering! And I am glad they did. This is my go-to place for Thai. I have never had a bad dish from this place. I usually buy an extra container of Tom Yum or Tom Kha to take home with me because it is so delicious. So is their green papaya salad!
Always excellent food and service. The panang curry is flavorful and delicious! You won't be disappointed.

Me and my girl were looking for a place to eat and we looked thru yelp and found this interesting place. Had a bit of a hard time finding a parking but so worth the wait since this is a great place to eat and amazing lunch specials. The service was excellent made me fell at home , great customer service. We got to meet Apple with a wonderful personality. Will definitely be coming back. New place that just recently opened a great place with many wonderful dishes to try. Great hospitality.
Man the food is amazing!!!! Came on Thursday and came back two days later . The service was good as well

This place is the go to place in the valley, there honest and the food is top of the line good portions!!!! This is my go to place from now on! I have been searching for a reall good Thai restaurant and I finally found it!!!!!!!!

Drove almost 40 mins just try the Thai food because I saw it recommended when I searched up authentic pad Thai. Let me tell you, it was worth every mile. Easily the best pad Thai I've had in years!! I also ordered some orange chicken, spicy basil, and Thai teas and they were all solid. Service was great and fast and the server was polite and got me everything I needed with no hesitation. Their Thai fish sauce is super good and spicy and whats a plus is that it goes on with just about everything they serve. If you haven't tried this restaurant, IT IS A MUST TRY.
Great tasting food at a very reasonable price. We got the Pananag Curry and Larb. Both were excellent!
This place is a must. All their curries are delicious and perfect during cold weather. Good selection of veggie options as well.

My husband and I were in town from Monterey for a night and decided we wanted Thai food. We found this restaurant on YELP and since it had great reviews we decided to try it. Long story short, this was THE BEST THAI FOOD we have ever eaten! I got chicken pad Thai and the flavor and spice was on point. My husband ordered the curry chicken, and while I'm not a huge fan of curry, I could've swam in that sauce! It was delicious!! I felt a little emotional while eating the food The owner waited on us, and I couldn't believe that they had been opened for barely two weeks! She was so friendly, attentive and knowledgeable. I highly recommend this restaurant!! We would drive the 4+ hours just to eat here again!!

This is definitely a newer restaurant but it has the best Thai I've had in a while. Yes, it's a little smaller than average but there are a large variety of food you can pick from. We got curry, soup, and others and all of it was delicious! The service is quick and the owner is so friendly and interactive. Definitely check this place out if you're craving some good Thai food! The mango and sticky rice is to die for by the way!
Some of the best Thai food I've had in a long time. I was bummed to learn they were shutting down for a bit, but can't wait until it reopens!
AWESOME! Have been coming here for years at their old location-they are the best! Love all the dishes we have tried.
Amazingly tasty good food. Highly recommend the Pad Thai if you're not into really spicy food (that would be me!) and any of the curries if you like it spicy! My hubs loved it all. 5 stars!
Nice small Thai Food restaurant with friendly staff and great food. Ordered several times online and in person over the years. This place is really good Thai food. Must try!

I placed an order online for pick up, takeout, to go, on the Yelp app thru Eat24. This was on a very slow Sunday night. It was for panang curry chicken and Pad Thai chicken. I specifically requested mild spice for each of my dishes. I also paid an extra $2 to get extra chicken in my panang curry chicken. I qualified for a free Thai iced tea and I ordered that too, through the app. This was all done through the computer so it was all clearly on my order ticket. When I went to pick up my order, there was only one couple in the restaurant. It was a very slow time. The Thai iced tea was not included with my order, I had to ask for it. When I got my food home to eat, both dishes were extremely spicy - the chef had ignored my specification for mild spice. Also there was no extra chicken in my panang curry. I paid 2 extra dollars to get the extra chicken and it was not included. In fact, it seemed like there was less chicken than normal for some reason. It seemed as though the chef ignored the specifications on the order ticket and just gave me the default orders with extreme spice and no extra chicken. Then, the person putting together my order to go ignored the Thai iced tea that was also clearly on the order ticket. This restaurant cannot be trusted to make an order accurately. If you order your food for takeout - beware. Check the whole order, including taste the dishes before you leave the restaurant to make sure they're not the wrong spice level. It's too much trouble for me as a customer to worry about these things so I will never return to this restaurant again. There are plenty of excellent Thai restaurants in the close vicinity that will give you exactly what you order. I will be patronizing them from now on. I suggest you do the same.

The food there is good. Had the Orange Chicken. Nice and crispy outer with good chicken. The crab cheese Rangoon's were good but the four tips were a bit over cooked. Food is fresh made when you order. Small busy parking lot

Would never drive by this place and think I should pop in... But thanks for the reviews on here it was something I was willing to try. Hands-down the best panang curry In the valley so far... That's no small thing.
This is solid Thai food. I love Spice Up Thai. It's my go-to Thai place in the Valley. Their Chow Mein and yellow curries are both exceptional.

I ordered takeout from here on uber eats' and the food is really delicious! Everything was cooked with amazing flavor. Also the price is good for the portions. I definitely recommend this place for anyone looking for good thai food!!! I can't speak much on the service because I didn't eat inside, but our food arrived quite fast with uber eats delivery.

Who else was bummed when Sweet Basil just got up and left us like we meant nothing to them ?!! Spice Up Thai took it's place and after complaining about not having good Thai since Sweet basil left we decided to go in and try the new place. Food was excellent ! Started with the Spicy chicken salad(Mild) and my it was HOT but delicious. Mocos running down my nose and sweaty face but oohhhh sooo good. Thai tea was perfection, Chicken Satay has a great flavor and the Pad Thai was excellent . The owner was so friendly and kept checking in with us and even offered to take the salad off of our menu since I said it was spicy . Place got a new face lift and the go go orders wouldn't stop coming in so they are doing something right . A must try !
Super delicious drunken noodles! They have a spicy sauce on the side so I can add myself to taste.
BEST THAI FOOD I'VE EVER HAD (PERIOD) I order their food weekly, and I am never disappointed, from the egg rolls to the mango sticky rice simply delicious. Apple rocks, she is such a sweetheart.
The food NEVER fails. We always get the food to go AND the way they package it remains HOT until we arrive at home. Food is very flavorful. My whole family enjoys their food.

Great Thai food. They were 10 mins from closing and still took my huge order. With this pandemic going on it seems as if everything closes super early now. Thanks Spice Up Thai Eatery for taking the extra time to care.

This place is phenomenal, the Tom Yum soup is one of the best I've ever had. I've tried a few other Thai eateries in the area with better ratings than here and they do not even come close in comparison.

Love this place! Great customer service and the food taste great! My husband and I have tried the orange chicken, dynamite wings, chicken fried rice, any type of chow mein, egg rolls, tom yum soup, and basil chicken everything is yummy!

Came here for lunch. Once of the best Thai food around. Tried to order sticky rice but it wasn't available. The dumpling is good. Make sure if you don't like spicy food tell them no chili because mild is still very spicy. Ordered the basil with beef it is really good.

I wanted this to be a 5 star review, but sadly, my expectations weren't met. The food took 45 minutes and the place wasn't even that busy! The food was mostly just OK. The wings were the best; excellent flavor! I'm going to try to duplicate them . I will definitely try them again for lunch. An $8 special really can't be beat!

I've been a customer here for a cue of years and enjoyed eating here, but the customer service is very poor and the guy that sits in the front and takes the orders is rude and got upset and threw a fit because I order a meal 45 minutes before close. I figured the guy was having a bad day and didn't really look into it. But then another incident happened because I asked question and was polite and he blew up like he was irritated... I will never go back again.. Food is good but the customer service is bad

Average Thai place. Food was okay. Small place in strip center with very reasonable prices. Tip if you order curry with tofu, order it at least medium to give it some flavor. If you're in the mood for a quick Thai meal, this would be fine.

Best Thai restaurant in the Valley! Great service! Great prices! They have both Thai and other options so you can go with the whole family! HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!! I had the Thai version of shrimp chow mein and the fried wontons and both were fabulous! My boyfriend had the spicy basil and loved it! We definitely will turn this place into a regular of ours.
Ever since new owner , this is the best whole in the wall restaurant for thai food. The padthai is my favorite! I love the environment and the service! Great food

Was looking for a local Thai restaurant and ended up finding this place on Yelp. Questioned the fact that the place was empty, the food wasn't bad but wasn't amazing either. Ordered the pad see ew and thai iced tea. Have tasted better but if you're looking for a place to satisfy your basic thai food cravings, come here! Tried ordering the mango sticky rice dessert but found out that mangoes weren't in season AND they were not serving any desserts at that time.
best pad thai ive ever had in my life and amazing portions come back soon we miss you ):

It's very good but I noticed they tend to put a lot of veggies and not enough protein in meals. Last time I got tofu soup and it seemed like 25% tofu and rest veggies, and this time I got Mongolian beef and it's about the same ratio meat to veggies. I have to eat more protein as part of my diet, so was hoping for $10 it would be more meat. I do like the eggs rolls, rice, and fried won tons!
Had the spicy padseew it was so good perfect spice level everything was fresh !! So glad I found this place it's a gem
