text: Take out. Does that look appetizing? It's not. I know it's Thai beef jerky but trust me, done right, this could be the most savory and tasty dish. Sanamluang does it right. It's too skinny, stringy/dry and tasteless. It's suppose to come with a side of SAUCE. Also presentation...put it on a bed of lettuce with a side of tomatoes. The chicken yellow curry is decent. I seriously don't understand why you think this is edible.

I had read that Spice Up Thai Eatery could make items vegan but I'm a bit iffie on that. I've ordered from this restaurant twice and I'm certain that non-vegan items found their way into my order, namely sauce, and perhaps more. If you have any dietary restrictions or allergies, I suggest you dine in. Maybe speaking to the servers will give you a better chance of having a properly cooked meal. I haven't eaten here with a meat eater so I can't comment on other dishes. Seems like average, ok Thai food.
I knew the owner from my favorite Thai resturamt. Now she owns her own. I found the flavors as good as my favorite Thai restaurant. This one is closer and they make deliveries. Great for take out.

Its hard for me not to order the Orange Chicken from Spice Up Thai every night! This place is great! I've eaten in, taken out, and ordered delivery from them without ever being disappointed. Some of my other favorites: Mongolian Beef, Cashew Nut Chicken, Spicy Beef Salad, and Dynamite Wings. Everyone who works there is always friendly and knowledgeable about the menu. My only disclaimer is this place is SERIOUS about spice, so be prepared for major HEAT is you order something spice. They also have great lunch specials for $8!! (You only get the free Tom Yum if you dine in)

You gotta love this restaurant. This is the fifth time I have had lunch here. The owner and servers are amazing! They gave me the 5 star treatment. The food is super tasty especially their Orange Chicken. I know that this is a typical item for most people but they REALLY do have great Orange Chicken! I also ordered other Thai dishes like Glass Noodle Salad and Beef Salad. Sooo good! I would definitely go back again and again!!

Just ordered Spicy Fried Rice and Red Curry from this Restaurant and it's so yummy!!!!! The owners are super nice . I drive from Van Nuys to pick up food from here for my work family just because it's just too good

We went bc the rating was high. Went for lunch. Terrible terrible aweful food. Fried rice: no flavor and white. Potstickers: cold. Flavorless worst food. The comment the owner wrote below is wrong. I did not go w a group. I with one friend. They never asked how good was
Super Yummy!!! Pad Thai & Crab Rangoons. Service was great, place is clean. Parking is a challenge due to small parking lot. Will be back.

My family and I craved some Thai food during Covid Lockdown and our usual Thai place was closed that day. So we found Spice Up Thai Eatery, which was great. Friendly service, great tasty food and reasonable prices.

TERRIBLE! I got the Pad See Ew with Beef and Shrimp My Gawd! Worst Pad See Ew I've had IN MY LIFE! Everything tasted old.. The noodles were dry and flavorless.. the beef was dry and chewy.. the 3 shrimp I paid an extra $2 for.. must have been old because it was Extra Fishy I just had Really good Pad 2 nights before, so I was excited to try it at another place... Boy do I regret that. I also got the "Dynamite" Chicken Wings There was surely nothing "Dynamite" about them! They taste like Yoshinoya's chicken wings, just as small, yet in a more watery spicier sauce. All around Epic Fail! This just goes to show You Can't Trust People's Reviews I could have went to at least 2 other nearby Thai places.. where I'm sure things couldn't have been any worse.. But this one had the highest rating (On Google Maps). (face palm) Not to mention, I asked for chopsticks from the boy at the register, his reply was "I put two forks in the bag".. . Forks and Chopsticks are Apparently the Same Thing Everybody! You learn something new everyday! Also the ambiance is more that of a Pizza Parlor than what the pics would lead you to believe, not that it's a bad thing. I gave it a 1 in hopes to even out this stupidly high score of theirs, it was really more of a 2. It didn't appear dirty, in the front at least, and the order was done quickly. Largely cuz no one was there... $23 down the drain I won't be back Edit: I'm the type of person to only review if the food was Amazing or TERRIBLE! Which is my right.. and The food here was Terrible! I made sure to read all the other low reviews before I commented. They All said the same thing.. "chewy low quality beefy" "bland noodles" "no Thai flavors".. I didn't lie about a Single thing. And I feel comfortable with everything I've said knowing your employees are "thief's" "rude" and "lack attention to detail". Yes again.. I've read Every single one of your bad reviews before I replied. You all can cry as much as you like while refusing to accept the fact you serve crappy food, but you still serve crappy food. Why would I want a repeat? I called you all in hopes you would actually change, because your food can't be of quality or fresh. I wrote my review to let Everyone know to not waste their money. And now I can add " Management is rude and controlling, blaming customers for their faults". You read Every comment made here yet you still serve the same crap with the same issues that can be read in each review. Shame on you! Oh and I ate the order piping hot, I burned my tongue lol.. It's my Favorite Thai dish, I've had it many times elsewhere.. How can your beef cooling make it so chewy and tough.. Or your shrimp so fishy (a sign it's gone bad). And thank you for confirming that your employee thought Chopsticks and Forks were interchangeable to an American wow.. If you would have remained quiet and let me have my opinion, I would have never had to add salt to the wound. Lastly, who cares if I'm bitter!? Bitter people eat too! Enjoy Bis!

I ate here yesterday because I had some time to kill before my hair appointment! I enjoyed the food and the price is very cheap! I got the Pad Thai lunch and it came with salad/ goyzas/ rice and pad Thai! I loved the noodles because it had so much flavor! I'm only putting 4 stars because the of the seating in the restaurant need to be updated as there were many tears in the booths! I would definitely come back if I have some time to kill at my next appointment!

Very delicious food! We got chicken pad thai, soup, sweet and sour chicken, and edamame. The sweet and sour chicken was a little overly battered but it was very delicious. Only down side is the parking situation but that has nothing to do with the restaurant itself. The lot is quite small and there were a few men yelling as well as liquor bottles and pillows laying around the front door of the restaurant. Besides that inconvenience,the restaurant has amazing food and I would come again!

Ok, so I have found another EXCELLENT spot for Pad Thai. I was there for the first time on Sunday this past weekend and was not disappointed. The portion was large and there was a good amount of chicken in the dish. The only problem I had was that they were not running their air conditioning. This IS a problem when it's nearly 100° outside and humid! (I seem to be finding this issue a lot lately). Oh, and the parking for the restaurant is absolutely terrible, there is a 7-11, a Subway, and a 2 for 1 Pizza Co. in the same tiny L-shaped strip mall. There are few spaces, they are very small and it's busy. But Spice Up, cannot help those things. So parking across the street might be an option if all the spaces are full, and they very likely will be. Given the situation with the A/C, I would recommend ordering to go or have them deliver if you are in their service area. (I have no direct experience with delivery from them). I will be back again. But maybe when it's cooler or they decide to run the air.

This location used to be my favorite Thai Food restaurants in the San Fernando Valley, but something has gone terribly wrong. I ordered my favorite plate (Spicy Thai w/chicken) and the flavor was very unenjoyable. I don't know what happened to this place. My guess is that it's under new ownership with a different cook. I've had this dish in numerous restaurants so I know what it should taste like. The cook missed the mark by a long shot. They need to bring back the old cook, or send this one to get some lessons. * The service was good * The restaurant was clean * The food was nasty

Love this spot. Orange Chicken lunch is great and so is their pork fried rice. The Tom Yum Chicken soup is the best here. It's close to my job but unfortunately the parking lot sucks. Worth it though.

I wanted panang curry but I also wanted an abundance of mixed vegetables...I asked to modify the panang curry (with beef as my protein) adding MIXED vegetables. Chef gave me a few suggestions but I told him exactly what I liked and he made it work. SO DELICIOUS...Hope he sees this because I am going to order it again it was savory, lots of umami but still easy on the stomach due to all the vegetables. Thank you, it was lovely.
We can't get enough of this place. Even with 5 minutes to spare they honored the lunch special which comes with this amazing honey mustard like dressing that i pour over everything lol

I ordered pick up last night and had the worst experience ever. The food was honestly below average and I really am not the type to write bad reviews unless it's warranted. The Tom Yum tasted very sweet- It shouldn't taste sweet, it's a sour and spicy soup.... anyways. The shrimp in my tom tum was OLD. The pad see yew tasted like it was cooked in old oil and the noodles were all stuck together. The only dish I could stomach was the orange chicken and brown rice. The rest of it went in the trash and was a waste of money. Never returning.

My partner and I always hit this place up when we're craving some good Thai food. The soups are some of the best I've ever had in any restaurant. Definitely recommend this spot. The food has a very delicious homemade flavor you just can't beat.

I'm not a fan of Spice Up Thai Eatery. I ordered the chicken pad Thai, orange chicken and egg rolls. The chicken pad thai was ok. The orange chicken was fried too crispy and i didn't like the sauce and the egg rolls are bland. If i do return it'll be for the chicken satay sticks that i thought was coming with this order but it didn't make it upon delivery.

The previous restaurant was better than this one - this Thai restaurant fails in comparison. Its meals are not as flavorful and the tofu isn't fried tofu. I don't even know if it was cooked tofu! It makes me sad because the location is so close to my house !
Best Thai food around!!! I love the staff they're always so fun to talk to and their food is so delicious and it comes out so fast!!
Great place to grab a great bite to eat, Super friendly staff and always helpful when i cant decide what to get.
Great food! Great service, we are lucky to have found this gem in our new neighborhood. Only gripe is parking but totally worth it. Great orange chicken and pad see ew. Oh and pineapple fried rice!
I recommend the Thai chicken basil dinner special . it comes with chicken delicious dumplings ,rice ,and a drink I recommend the Thai ice tea of course never fails .

It's hard to find good authentic Thai in the north valley. Spice it Up lives up to their name and takes their place at the head of the table for north valley Thai! The noodles were spectacular... the Thom Ka not so much. The soup was far to sweet. Everything else was wonderful tho!
I've always liked this place, and though they've had owners changes... its only gotten better. Great quality food for great prices. They have amazing service too. Always a first choice for thai food.
Very good food and friendly staff! My favorite is the Spicy Beef Salad although everything is delicious!!

It was my first time going to this place and it was amazing. I was actually going to the subway next door but they have the menu right on the window and it just drew us right in. We ordered the chicken soup and 2 other plates and I just had to leave a good review.

I picked this place cause it has such great reviews online but was disappointed, the meat was dry and tasteless chili oil and soy sauce where musts didn't make it much better, the rice they use is cheap short grain rice I don't think I'll be back here hopefully I can find a decent Thai the Thai iced coffee was good tho the attendant/cashier was really really nice so that's a plus

The food was amazing and they had many options. I specifically had the Pad Se Ew and it was on point. I went for their 8 dollar lunch special but the options were limited for that. There is a $10 minimum for card so I ended up ordering a tea but she forgot about it. All in all I really went for the food and it was good. It's new so give it a try. Hopefully their service gets better.

I ordered the Orange Chicken Lunch special a few days ago. The price was right @ 8$ but the flavor wasn't anything special. The chicken was crispy and could have been excellent, but the sauce was 4/10 on Flavortown. Parking is horrendous so don't expect to find any readily available. The entrance to the restaurant smells like urine, vomit, and feces. Homeless people during the night I'm guessing. Please clean up the outside of your establishment. That means every morning if you have to. I will not be returning.
Consistently very great food and good service. One of my go to easy restaurants for pickup or quick dine in! Highly recommended.
First time here Good service, Great food, Clean place, Cozy condition. I really like the thai fried rice and for sure I will come back here

I have never written a yelp review, but I am just SUPER disappointed by this place and don't understand its 4 star rating. I ordered my food through door dash and didn't receive my peanut sauce. The pad-See-ew was so basic. Had no Thai flavors and maybe 5 pieces of broccoli. Tasted like something I could've made at home without trying too hard. :( the rice was also sub par. I'm so disappointed and definitely a waste of $30. I should've paid the $10 delivery fee from another place. I highly suggest you do not eat here if you're looking to fulfill your Thai food craving. If you're looking for mediocre food with some flavor, but not a Thai flavor then this is okay.

I am happy that my order was ready on time but very upset that my order was all wrong. My boyfriend went to go pick it up I just told him that I had already payed for it and it was under my name. I ordered mild pad Thai with chicken and a large thai tea. When he came home they had given him a small thai iced tea and spicy pad Thai. I am sensitive to spice so I couldn't eat it which I'm very upset about. This is the second time I come here the first time was delicious, it was also take out and the order came out perfectly. This time, I'm just disappointed.

I came here last night before they were about to close. I always give the benefit of the doubt to every new place I try. I called for a pick up order and it's normal service like every place else. Just always make sure when you go to any place that you'll be charged extra if you want rice with the order. The food was decent, parking is a problem since there's not much spots. I also ordered there sticky rice w/ mangos.. now that was yummy!! Will be back for more !! Price is decent as well.
Wanted some good food that would deliver. This hit the mark! No more cardboard, game tile pizza for us! So hit the spot!
Really good place very recommended combination rice was on point. Place was very clean and well remodeled to be honest the best thai food ever

Spicy noodles are delicious!! It was so flavorful! One of the best i've had. It wasn't too heavy and the portions are a good size! Unfortunately that's all I tried but i'll be back to explore the menu! They were very attentive.
solid food with good service too! I believe his name was Nicky and he was an excellent server! Would recommend
Love this place! I go almost once a week. Always great service and great food! Nicky is the man!
Probably one of the best Thai places I've eaten at! Customer service is great as well!

Having never been in the restaurant, I don't know what the actual location is like. My wife picked up some panang and green curry plus some orange chicken to go. We get Thai quite a bit and this is definitely above average. The green curry was one of the best I have ever had. We will be ordering from here again very soon, and I look forward to trying some of their other dishes.
Best Tom Yum soup I have ever had in my entire life. I will only go here going forward. It's crazy how good it is. Get it spicy if you like heat. So freakin' yummy!!!

Phenomenal atmosphere, service, and food. Since moving to the valley 3 months ago I have tried many different Thai places, but this one will now be my consistent spot. Food came out at an appropriate rather quickly and they paid close attention to water refills. All staff were friendly and I will certainly be going back.

Love this place! We come here all the time and it's always delicious. The Tom Kah (coconut milk soup), pad Thai, and red curry and Panang curry are our favorite. Also, the appetizer with roti and curry dipping sauce is dangerously good. Do not order because you will be craving to eat it again for the next week! So good! And the owner is very nice :)

Absolutely amazing customer service on the phone, I've called many Thai places in the area, they're always short and nasty on the phone Nicky was really REALLY nice... He was very helpful, he took his time, he was patient and most important he was professional and friendly. I also really really like the food, it was very gourmet and the prices were amazing you will not be disappointed if you go to this place best Thai restaurant in the area period!! If I could give 10 stars I would !!!!!!
Good spot to eat , the food here is really delicious the rice noodles nick recommended were worth it glad I came here to eat for lunch
Tried for the first time tonight. We will definitely be back. All the food was really good and not oily like some places.
I came here for lunch and it was so good. I ordered the yellow curry lunch special and it was delicious. The food came out quickly and the service was great!!

This is probably the best Thai food Ive ever had. Definitely would recommend this with Thai cravings. The owner was great and always so attentive to us and everybody else. Great customer, service our food was great it was just right.
Great new place wonderful service and delicious food all around great spot for Thai food definitely worth trying.

Bomb little Thai spot. The food was delicious and they were fast at cooking it. The large Tom Kha coconut shrimp soup was top notch, prob one of the best I've tried. I've been to Ocha Thai in hollywood and a few other well known Thai spots. Good large portion to share with 2-3 ppl max, enough spice, and a sweet creamy flavor with all the right seasonings not to mention lots of shrimp (they don't skimp you on the shrimp). We also ordered the Shyly Shrimp, which were basically wonton wrapped shrimps deep fried and served with sweet and sour sauce. Perfectly cooked and the right crunch. The Thai ice tea was delicious as well. Chicken pad Thai was full of flavor and again a big portion worthy of sharing with 2 people. The guy was super cool and very attentive to service. I will mention one thing, I ordered the chicken fried rice and me personally it was not my cup of tea. I didn't notice they put basil leaves it in and I don't like basil but that's not their fault, my fault for not reading the menu properly. All in all, try this spot. Lots of take out orders and plenty of seating space. They are definitely doing something right when it's super busy!
Very good super fresh ingredients with lots of flavors. Service is excellent and over all the cleanliness of the establishment is great. I will definitely be going back to enjoy great service food .
This place is so good!! My husband and I are both vegan and they can make lots of yummy things vegan (the green curry is so good) We will definitely be back = )

We just stumbled upon this little hole in the wall place. We each ordered a lunch special and for $9 it's a great deal! It came with the most amazing spicy soup with ginger and lemongrass in it. I tried the pad thai and my boyfriend had the Mongolian Beef. Both were delicious! The waiter, Nicky, was friendly and he made great conversation with us. They were pretty busy, but we got served at lightning speed!

This restaurant is real Thai food. The owner, Apple, personal taste every dish to make sure it is consistent. She won't serve it to a customer if it doesn't meet her standards. Best Thai food in town.

Amazing food, but horrible experience otherwise. Ordered through Door Dash (which btw the prices didn't see too different compared to their in person menu?). Ordered pick up and received a notification it was ready, so drove myself there to pick it up. The parking in this plaza is awful so don't even try to pull in as it's a nightmare and there's always people trying to get in/out of the tight spots, as it shares a plaza with 7-11. Just save yourself the trouble and park on the street and walk. So upon arrival I essentially watched them make my entire order even though it was "ready" - eg waited another 20 minutes for the food. I can't imagine how this would have played out if I had actually ordered delivery from Door Dash. It was almost as if they forgot or didn't even know the order was in place. As for the food itself, I got the pad Thai and Pad see ew. Both tasted different, in a good way, than the standard Thai I've had at other places. These dishes seemed more flavorful and dare I say - authentic? The noodles in the pad Thai were different, more thin/vermicelli like and the sauce was surprisingly brown, not orange like the usual Americanized Thai food and that's ultimately why I thought it was more authentic. Overall, I'd get this again, if I was brave enough to endure the total experience and troubles associated with this place.
Their lunch is pretty good. You get a lot of value for $8 lunch. Customer service is nice as well. I will recommend this place! Nice Thai joint in the area!

The food was surprisingly good. I've tried many Thai restaurants in the S. F. Valley, but Spice Up exceeded my expectations. I was inspecting the strip mall where they are located and decided to have lunch there and boy I am glad I did. Service was great, price was moderate but the food really tasted like it was homemade. Love the little fried wontons with the special sauce. My wife will definitely Love this place. I met the owner and she takes pride in her cooking. Yes, the owner is the chef!

We have been to Spice Up Thai three times, the first two with coupons. Service has always been friendly and adequate, although they were sometimes too busy with takeout orders to to be very attentive. My wife always orders Crying Tiger. The first time it was just OK, but the second, for some reason, it was truly excellent, which prompted our third trip there. I ordered the pork ribs the first trip and it was not the best. The second trip I got the pork fried rice which was quite good. Our third trip there we took a couple of friends. My wife's Crying Tiger was again not the best (not very flavorful). One of our friends got the Mongolian beef, which she said was very good. I ordered the pork fried rice again and the other friend the mixed vegetables with pork. Interestingly both of us were served chicken rather than pork and both would have preferred the pork. We were running a little late so we accepted the food as is. I'm sorry to give so much detail, but the point being made that they are probably capable of providing a tasty meal but they are rather unorganized quite uneven in the quality of their food. I'm afraid I can only give them three stars.

This place is delicious. Probably my favorite restaurant when I want to dine out. The food is delicious and fresh, the restaurant is clean and very cozy and the staff is very friendly and attentive. The portions are generous and the prices are very affordable. I had the Tom Kha (coconut soup) with chicken and my wife had the orange chicken with rice. Again, really tasty and fresh. We plan on coming here often.

Most amazing Thai food in the valley! No one else compares from all the ones I have tried. The flavor is on point, they always get the order right, they poke holes in the eggroll container so you aren't left with soggy egg rolls when you get home, and the Thai tea is delicious too! The only downside is the parking situation but I will go there all the time now just bathe food is so worth it. The glass noodle salad is like wow!! Love it. Great place. Go find out for yourself!
Simply amazing Tom Yum Noodle soup here! I love this little place! Prompt amiable service and my soup was mouth watering. Come!!!
Open new..good food ,nice owner apple ...good place people go try it....it's large menu

Found this little restaurant on yelp while I was leaving the bank and craving some Thai. Upon pulling up I was instantly turned off and almost didn't eat here. The parking lot is small and for multiple businesses. I happened to find a spot so I decided to go in, I'm glad I did. The restaurant is very open and clean. There are booth seats which is also a plus. Now for the food, I ordered chicken pad Thai and the crying tiger dish ( which is basically steak strips with a delicious sauce ). The crying tiger dish was sooooo good it actually came with a lot of meat too. The chicken pad Thai was also very good. Not dry like some other places. The service was also amazing, I never once had to ask for a refill and I drink ALOT of water. Would definitely come back soon.
The food was fresh and tasty. Prices were very reasonable and the staff was nice. I will definitely come back again

Fresh and delicious. They don't skimp on ingredients. We had the spicy beef salad, spicy chicken salad, chow mein, spring rolls, garlic green beans with chicken and crying tiger. The only thing that was subpar was the crying tiger, because it was very dry. Otherwise everything was really tasty and this will be our new Thai spot

I am so bummed to leave this review, since we have been eating here and loving it for years but today (I think the name changed?) we picked up our food and it was not flavorful at all. The curry tasted like curry paste with coconut milk, no other flavors and the mongolian beef literally tasted like nothing. It was so bland. We had to mix it with the curry to attempt to enjoy it. I am sad to say we will not be back.
n absolute blast. Nicky is a funny, charismatic server, and the Spicy Basil is out of this world. Also, don't forget to try the Tom Kha Soup! Truly unbelievable Thai food at a very affordable price.
Delicious food at a great price!! Awesome customer service as well! I tried the red curry and truly was delicious! Would highly recommend! Will definitely be coming back
I have been coming here for a while and this place has a very cozy atmosphere. I love their pad see we and yellow curry!

The only criticism I have of this place is the lighting, and booths are too low. When you go in your knees raise. Not a good seat for body posture. If you're a tall person your knees might touch the table. There is chair seating which is fine. Upon entering the restaurant, they were ringing up one person. There was no one but me & boyfriend in restaurant, 3 workers and it took them almost 10 min after the takeout customer left to greet us/take order. Call me picky, I've worked in food service, so yeah. They are great for take out. The pad Thai had too much sauce/very oily. The rice noodles were spaghetti size. Normally it's a flat noodle. And, all the pad Thais I've had haven't had so much sauce. Ordered Tom kha mild. It was delicious but was a wee more spicy than I'd like. Overall, good place.
This place is amazing ! The food is always fresh, hot and tasty. We order the Wonton soup and pad Thai .

Not all Thai Teas are created equal and by golly this one takes the cake!!! best Thai tea I've had in a long long time! The owner here is the sweetest and they deliver for free within 3miles and my fam lives super close. On a rainy day like today, this place will be frequented by us for sure!!! Ordered the TomYum soup w chkn and shrimp and it smells delicious and tastes even better!!! So happy this place is so close and so good. Def recommend u try this gem!

The best and most authentic Thai food in all of Los Angeles!!! My husband and I LOOOOVE Thai food; we have Thai food several times a week. We've been all over the valley and beyond in search of good Thai food (Northridge, Chatsworth, Burbank, Sherman Oaks, Van Nuys Westlake Village, Pasadena, Downtown, etc.) and have a recommendation for a great Thai restaurant in every part of the valley. We love Thai food so much we took a two week vacation to Thailand! Of all of the restaurants we've been to, this one our favorite by far! The Tom Yum was delicious - could have been spicier - but still VERY flavorful. The green and yellow curries were rich, creamy, and perfectly spiced. The owners are very friendly, the service is excellent, and the restaurant is very clean. I can't wait to keep going back so I can try everything on the menu. For anybody that loves authentic Thai food, you will LOVE Spice Up Thai!!
I just found out about this place on yelp so happy that they open in my neighborhood I really like Thai coffee with bobae and beautiful interior highly recommended

My husband and I just recently discovered this place and we are SO happy we did. We just moved to the area 2 years ago and tried many other Thai restaurants but this is the winner. We walked in on a Sunday night and the guy at the counter was really nice and recommended a few dishes. We ordered the lum ka nad, spicy noodles and chicken satay and they were all so good and fresh! We've been ordering from here since then. This place deserves a 5 star review for the quality of the food, cleanliness and services. Thank you spice up Thai!
Excellent food and excellent customer service. My favorite is Pad See Ew and it was so good. Nick server provided me an excellent service. Thank you Spice Up Thai

Don't do dine-in here. We were the only other customers along with one other party and service just sucked. You'd think it wouldn't be an issue to wait for a check or for water, but nope. They cater to the delivery and ToGo orders. Food was just okay and spicy as they are named. Won't go back.
Omg may I say the food is FREAKING DELICIOUS. Service was great friendly, the food amazing as if my momma or auntie made it .. may I say fresh and fast service and great lunch special 8 bucks

I try spicy basil leave with ground chicken med spicy and coconut soup med spicy OMG !!!! I can't believe it the test so good and love it love this place and Servies apple very friendly she so nice I will came back !!!!! U should try

Delicious and fresh. We didn't have a lunch special but we did go for lunch. Ended up getting the seafood soup, dumplings steamed and papaya salad. It was all super fresh and did not taste like it had been sitting there for a week. Dreaming about the soup ever since. Going back soon.
Really cool place live the look of it and really nice people here food is bomb forget vim

I use to go to Rincome Thai for years but lately their food hasn't been that good. Wanted to try a new Thai spot so I tried Prem's Thai kitchen and they were pretty good. I then came across Spice Up Thai on yelp and wanted to give it a try because it's close to home. Needles to say, Spice Up Thai is my new go to for great Thai food! Best Thai food I've had in the valley!

Used to be way better then when it was sweet basil thai. Ordered spicy garlic green bean with meat and a side of fried rice. I don't how the fried rice has more meat than the main dish. FYI there's only one size fried rice. Whether it has meat or not it's still the same price doesn't make sense but ok. All in all it was way better before than what it used to be.
I miss Vince when it was Sweet Thai Basil, but this place hasn't skipped a beat! The Tom Kha was on point as was the remodeling. Good luck & much success!

I took my mom out here today for her birthday because she loves Thai food and other yelp users gave it the highest rating for a Thai place in the San Fernando Valley. They were right to give it 5 stars and I am doing the same. The service was amazing! We were treated like royalty from the time we came in the door till we went out. The food was delicious and beautifully presented. When I told the waitress it was my mom's birthday she wished her a happy birthday and then surprised us by bringing out a dish of coconut ice cream with a candle free of charge after the meal. The atmosphere was very nice with soft music in the background. The restaurant is beautifully designed with simple but colorful and well thought out decor. I highly recommend this place and will definitely be back!
Food is okay... I miss Sweet Basil's Thai food and service. Waitress was definitely unattentive to customers.
I am very happy to eat dinner yesterday at Spice Up Thai restaurant. Excellent food & also the service provided by Apple. I recommend all my friends to eat in this Restuarant
This small cozy place has amazing food! Orange chicken is bomb and fried rice was so good too. The owners (i think it was them) were really nice!

This was my first time trying Spice Up and I was disappointed. I ordered the papaya salad - it was completely drenched in spicy vinegar and it just killed the whole salad. I really wanted to get some is the sweetness from the papaya. The salad also came with a large wedge of cabbage, which didn't compliment the salad very well. I also ordered the Pad Thai. The only thing I enjoyed in this dish was the shrimp. The noodles were very overcooked and clumped together. The tamarind based sauce tasted very generic and American (like that of a jar you could get at a grocery store). Next is the Pad See Ew. Again, the noodles were extremely overcooked and clumped together. The dish was very very salty. The beef taste burnt and absolutely loaded with pepper or some spice that did not carry a pleasant taste. Probably one of the most sub-par plate of this usually delicious noodle dish I have ever encountered. I also had a side order of some pan fried dumplings. I am almost positive they were brought in from some distributor that probably also makes deliveries to the food court at your local mall. Would not recommend. Finally, the won-ton soup. This was delicious and I have no complaints. The broth had really good flavor. The food most definitely was not worth the $43 that I paid. I usually go to Hollywood and NoHo to get my Thai takeout, but I always try and give the local new Thai spots a try hoping I find a good spot close to home. Spice Up Thai gets 2 thumbs down from me.

The food was ok for the most part (ordered combination fried rice, mixed vegetables with chicken and beef, and yellow curry) but just ok. The curry I ordered mild but it was SO spicy it was inedible. I eat Thai food regularly and am not sensitive to the spice. Going to bed hungry tonight. Disappointed.
Best pad Thai in town!!! I loved all the selections in the menu. There Thai tea boba is also delicious.
I love coming here. The food is amazingly delicious. The people here are all friendly. My family comes here almost everyday so I don't have to cook

First time here since sweet basil closed down. I ordered the garlic pepper beef and a side of white rice. My friend ordered pad see ew with shrimp. Good ratio of shrimp to noodle and broccoli. She also a bowl of wonton soup. She absolutely loved the soup. She said the broth was the best part of the soup. I enjoyed my food. The beef was of great quality. The egg rolls we got had a bit of a frozen after taste to them. The host/waitress was great on checking in and refilling our waters. She even gave us a complimentary Thai iced tea.. My friend said the Thai tea was amazing! I don't like it over-all but I trust her word on that. I would come back and reccomend this spot to others. Nice friendly service.
Excellent food excellent value. I had pad see ew and spicy noodle. Both were great. Calamari was good too.
Not a bad choice for Thai food, and they deliver! Worth checking out.
Nice place. There was a small mistake that they took care of immediately. The food wasn't bad and the service ended up being beyond mediocre

This is now one of favorite Thai restaurants in my neighborhood. We ordered the BBQ pork ribs, spicy chicken wings and chicken fried rice. The meat on the ribs was flavorful and just fell off the bone. The chicken wings were crispy from the outside and tender from the inside. The flavor was sweet with a mild hint of spiciness. I've also had their lunch specials and you get so much food for less than $10. Love this place!

Best Thai food I've ever had the pad see eww, spicy beef salad, glass noddle, and tom kha soup all are amazing!!!! I would eat this evernight! Great price, and service was amazing! Such nice people!!!
The chicken my Tom Kah soup was over cooked and very tough great otherwise, the Pad Thai wasn't as fresh as would have liked, clumpy and sticky. The Calamari was great though. Very friendly host.

Clean interior, brightly lit, and great customer service that comes with a big smile from Lita every time I've been here. This time I had the Pad Thai with shrimp and they gave me a free gyoza appetizer for writing a Yelp review :) the Pad Thai was tasty and came out quickly, which I appreciated since I was super hungry. Some Thai restaurants have a bland Pad Thai with over cooked noodles, but this new restaurant does a good job with flavor overall and noodles were perfectly chewy and well seasoned. The gyoza was perfection, no complaints here! Big thing for me at Thai places is that they remember not to let any peanuts or peanut oil even touch my food because I'm deathly allergic (though I don't carry an epi-pen, too pricey! And I've been avoiding peanuts in my food for 29 years now, pretty familiar with which Southeast Asian dishes usually have them.) I have never had a problem with this here, they're very attentive to detail. The only struggle with eating here is that the parking lot is tiny, but the food & great customer service is worth it, so I keep coming. Besides, it's next to a Chinese massage spot!

Took a chance a few weeks ago on this place and was very satisfied with what we ordered. Came back again this past weekend to pick up our takeout order, but had to wait a bit only because parking in that small plaza lot is terrible. Other than that, we will definitely eat here again.
Hi everyone I recommend spice up Thai food :) if you are hungry for home made Thai come here the food is fresh and so good, service is great is family own. Owner is a doll and sweet person,
user_location: Granada Hills South, Los Angeles, CA

text: This is by far the best spot in the SFV for Thai Food. As authentic as it can get. The servers are extremely friendly and welcoming. To simply put it, great vibes, great food, and great people. This place is easily 5/5 stars.

The people here are so nice. Ordered vegan food for pickup and because the order took a little bit longer (with regular updates), the lady in the front brought me Thai tea. When I told her I couldn't have the Thai tea, she profusely apologized and offered to redo without milk. If their food tastes as good as their customer service I will be coming back. (PS I was not offered anything to write a review. It's nice to see people who care). This place seems to have definitely improved over the previous owners

I LOVE LOVE LOVE Spice Up Thai! By far my favorite restaurant! The food is always so so fresh and cooked with so much love you can see it in every dish. These people work so hard to fulfill their customers and make them happy. Truly am so thankful that i came across spice up Thai because literally everything on the Menu tastes incredible and the hospitality is amazing. My favorite is the Tom Yum soup and the green papaya salad:) ANY of their curry's are to die for and so authentic. Tastes so home cooked and delicious it will leave you wanting more lol. I pride them on how sweet and hard working they are, thanks for all that you do:) anything less then 5 stars for this place is a lie and I'll always be back.
Good food , can't say anything about the service because I never actually eaten in there. I only order delivery or take out. Prices are fair, food is food a must try if you're in the area

Last weekend, I ordered in delivery. Over the phone a man told me about 45-50 minutes until it would arrive. So we waited and at about an hour and twenty minutes past. I called back and asked them if the food was ready? If it wasn't then I no longer wanted it. The man told me that 3 out of 4 items we're ready. I told them no it's been over way over the time they gave me. I then hung up. About a minute later, I was called back. The same man said everything is ready, their driver was on the way back and he would give me 50% off of my $35 order. We agreed and said fine. In about 15 minutes a driver calls me from a personal number saying he's outside. So I took cash not knowing how much it would or wouldn't be. He greeted me nicely and apologized. I held out the cash getting ready to count. I asked him how much it was and he said he'd give a discount. I said yes, a discount. He said ok I charge you only $30. In my head I was just thinking about how I wanted the food and wanted all this over with. So I just handed it over and took in the food. Later on, my mom asked how much I paid. I told her $30. She was shocked saying the scammed me. I shouldn't have given more than $20. She called back the restaurant telling them they scammed us and we will not be returning back. The man told her that he instructed the driver to only charge $10!! My mom let him know that wasn't the case. I was told $30. The man tried to keep her on the line saying hold on the driver just came back and he would talk to him. My mom said no and that would be a personal business matter, but we would not be returning to the restaurant. About 5 minutes later, I was receiving 2 calls back to back from the driver's number. I did not answer, not knowing his intentions or wanting to deal with what happened. For us, it no longer mattered since what has been done is done. But the fact that I was told a discount to take the food, but charged a higher price is outrageous. Maybe the driver tried to take a $20 tip. Who knows? But this was not okay. It ruined the rest of our night and we had lost our appetite.
Amazing staff! Very clean and organized. Tom Yum Shrimp soup is my favorite. Great place to eat Thai. Definitely will order again!!

First time here , we were around the area and decided to stop in.. Food was. Delicios! Had the yellow curry ,orange chicken and pad thai super spicy noodles.. Had to wait about 30 mins for take out but the sweet lady gave me a free iced tea for waiting...the reason I'm giving them 3 is because of its location ...super small plaza with like maybe 10 super tight spots..dont know if they had additional parking in the back

First time ordering from this place. I was surprised of how fast the delivery guy came with my order. I ordered Pad See Ew and the Orange Chicken. I thought the Orange chicken was pretty good but was expecting rice to come with it. I guess not, no biggie. The Pad See Ew was just okay and I think it lacked flavor. I think maybe I'll give them another chance in the future and try some of their other plates.

I've been searching for good Thai spots around my area and I found this spot that has amazing Thai food I got the pad see ew and white rice and it was good the only problem I had was that I did wait a longer time than I expected for my food but overall food was good I will be returning soon nom nom
Great Thai food. Ordered the kang pao chicken and rice. Great customer service. Will definitely be returning.

The price is reasonable and the portions are HUGE. Their Pad Ka Nam Curry is delicious and they can make it as spicey as you can handle it! Their customer service is definitely the best around. The space is clean, fast service, and its usually quiet but you always have people walk in. Definitely have been here about twice and I try to remember to leave a review. But check these guys out. So worth it. Only thing is the parking lot is small but that's LA for you!

Authentic! Very affordable and amazing service especially after you introduce yourself. Me and my wife are big fans of thai food but it's very saturated and there's no more than 1 to 2 decent places in all of Los Angeles. Their food is great! Never too much sauce, but always lots of flavor. Veggie egg rolls are amazing...but then so is everything on their menu!!!!! Also great service each time we go in

I have been ordering food to go here for months. My favorite is their ground chicken pad ka paow. That this is so full of flavor. I love drizzling the sauce in my rice...so yummy! Their Pad see ewe also has delicious flavor. I knocked down one star because the Thai fried rice was really bland. I don't understand why it is since it has onions and tomatoes but it just lacks flavor. Also, there is a smell in the restaurant that I don't like. I can't quite put my finger on it but I can't stand it. I'm glad I only get the food to go.

Super tasty pad Thai! I ordered the lunch special with shrimp pad Thai and it was super flavorful and very filling. It came with 2 won tons, rice and a side salad. The Thai iced tea is great as well.....I can't wait to try the other items in the future and highly recommend trying this new spot!

I ordered the shrimp Tom kah soup and the chicken pad Thai and both were excellent. The portions were huge, I had leftovers for days. I also ordered the Thai tea and I will say it was very sweet, I kept trying to water it down, which seemed to make it last forever. I would definitely order from here again next time I'm craving great Thai food

Finally, a great thai place that is affordable and close to home. My wife and I have been here three times and everytime the food is excellent, authentic thai. We love the crab fried rice. Loaded with real crab meat. Pad Thai and Pad see ew are very tasty and fresh. Crying tiger is tender and seasoned just right. Love that we don't have to drive to reseda for real thai food. Owner is really nice, and food was on-time for take out all three times. Have yet to dine in but the restaurant is nice and clean. The only negative is the parking spaces are kind of tight but not a huge deal.

Tried for the first time tonight and I'm so happy that I did. I ordered a Thai iced tea and the garlic black pepper with vegetables and it was absolutely delicious! Nikki was great. Will definitely eat there again soon!
Best Thai food I've ever had . Ordered to go and the food was made in a timely fashion . The owner is lovely and the food was so amazing . Love the new remodel .

I have ordered from this restaurant twice. First time they were out of green beans so i had to pick a different entree. Tonight, tried them again & they were out of chicken and sticky rice! I ordered thru Eat24 who was completely unhelpful and didn't let me know they were out of these items so I didn't get to have dinner. They were 35 minutes late on the delivery & my friends meal was cold. I will not be ordering from this place again. I have no idea what their food tastes like because I have yet to actually get any of it other than pad thai.
Wow this place is delicious & great value. Friendly staff, very generous portions, great customer service. Tried several dishes and non disappointed!! Will be coming to dine-in and/or to-go order.

Incredible,Thai food.my new favorite place to eat in Granda Hills. treat yourself to the best Thai restaurant in the area.i love it.i was so impressed i was worried because they are new owners but wow it is so tasty and they are so nice wonderful experience!

Great place. The people here are very humble and sweet. The food is flavorful and they have a great variety of it. Definitely a place to go if you live in the Granada hills area. Enjoy mates, I know I did for sure !
Just got here, but so far so good! Fool looks great! Thai iced tea is delicious! Will review the food after we have been served. (Free appetizer with Yelp review)

My friend recommended this place but never had the time to come. When I finally came to this place I ordered the coconut soup and it was delicious. I also ordered the spice beef salad, the first bite was like heaven. I now love this place and this will be my go to thai place!!!

Ordered delivery from here twice and it had its highs and lows. The good: *Fast. Really fast. This is the fastest delivery I've ever had, which when your starving, is greatly appreciated. *The wings are very, very good. Not too spicy and full of flavor. *The orange chicken. On the spicy side, but crisp and tasty. *the BBQ pork ribs. These are fall off the bone, rich, and delicious. They made great leftovers *free Thai iced tea. Hard to argue with. The bad: *Pad Thai. The chicken was actually so dry it was crumbly. The noodles were mushy and there was a shocking lack of flavor. Very disappointing. *the rice. Somehow dry and mushy at the same time. I think they may not have cleaned it before cooking? Overall a good experience, but definitely with room for improvement.

Rainy day & I was looking for comforting tasty soup. Did a Yelp in my hood & found Spice up Thai eatery. Decided to give it a shot. Ordered small Tom Yum Soup & a Thai salad. Both very tasty. The soup was exactly what I was looking for. Warm, flavorful & light. The salad flush with greens, tomatoes, cucumbers, egg, carrots & onions with a side of Thai dressing. Hit the spot! And My go to Thai spot in neighborhood

If I could I would give this place 10 stars. They close at 9 but if you call them and tell them you're on your way they'll wait for you and tell you to take your time, and they'll treat you with no rush. They're super friendly and most important part everything on the menu is great!
Loved this place, the food was fire and the waiter was very nice and courteous, I'll definitely be returning here in the future!

It's good food, to be sure. I've had it delivered a couple of times and they had some issues getting the order right (specifically, I have a relative allergic to bell peppers and they left them in twice after specially ordering the dishes with no bell peppers) However, the food definitely tastes good, arrived on time, and was fairly priced.

This was the most disappointing Thai food experience I have ever had. The chicken that was used to make their orange chicken was old. The Tom kha noodles had a strange sweaty sock flavor. I would avoid this place if you are looking for authentic Thai food. If you're looking for Americanized Thai food, this is your jam!
I'm super happy this place opened up in the neighborhood! The food is really good and super cheap. Everything is fresh and well-made. The Thai Beef Salad is AMAZING!!!
Friendly service and eager to accomodate vegetarian requests. Delicious, we shared the Tom Kha Soup with tofu and Spicy Eggplant.
Probably the best Thai in the area! Pad Thai Shrimp and the Panang are must haves. Definitely authentic. Love the mango and sticky rice also!
Best Thai food in the valley! Friendly staff and fast service. Parking sucks so I park across the street. Panang curry rocks so do the soups
This is horrible...When you order a vegetable and tofu pad thai with no peanuts they still add peanuts to the meal when clearly someone has a really bad peanut allergy!!!
showed up 730pm on a saturday, walked in, only 2 people there, guy says " we have a big order ahead of you so it's going to take 25 minutes" no thanks, sheesh
Good food excellent service!!!!! Strongly recommend!!! And the price is super reasonable!!!! You will love this friendly restaurant!!!

LOVE THEIR FOOD My favorite dish at any Thai restaurant is combination fried rice. & with every restaurant they have their own spices but Spice Up Thai Eatery is by far my favorite! I go all the time and the staff is wonderful :)

I had lunch today with my hubby and it was our first time eating there let me say that it was a amazing experience not only the food was so good customer service was excellent and this place so clean for sure we will be going soon!
Everyone here is extremely nice and always great service every time I've come here. The server is amazing and the owner is the sweetest owner I've met.
This restaurant is my favorite Thai spot in Granada Hills. The restaurant is clean, the food is delicious, and the people are very attentive and nice.

I have been coming here for a couple years now ever since they switch ownership and I have nothing but positive things to says. I love their Pad Thai, Tom Ka soups, and spicy fried rice. They can get busy at time during the dinner rush but the wait is worth it.
l am a vegetarian and I alway order the vegy fried rice or the vegy chowmein. these two are alway delicious. i recommend this place 100 percent

This place is delicious!! I've ordered from here multiple times! Their food speaks for Itself- so glad to have found this gem of a place...good food with reasonable prices! Would recommend and will definitely be coming here and ordering more from them more often.

Just ordered the chicken pad Thai, pork fried rice & orange chicken. All REALLY good! My only complaint is white rice is extra. I love pad Thai, and I don't know if it's because I told him I like my pad Thai extra sweet? But it came out saucy and super delish!
The portions are amazing for the price! The foods always good, I love the pineapple curry with tofu. I eat here whenever I come to Granada hills!
Awesome attentive customer service and great Thai food. Overall enjoyable time with friends

Great new shop. Right down the block for me. Very fair prices and the quality of the food is what you pay for. If you want quick and fresh Thai food, this is the place to go! Ordered the spicy fried rice to go and it was delicious!

I will not come here again. The customer service is very bad. The girl that took our order seemed bothered with our request. Our Soup was more noodles then soup. I asked if she can add soup the actual liquid she said "no what you think I can just add it?!"I have to make it. It was a two people soup, it seemed like a bowl for one. She could've said sure it will be a little extra. I could've paid for extra soup so I can finish noodles. They might as well gave me a bowl of noodles only, also it was shrimp flavor I only got 5 shrimps and not enough mushrooms.

Heard about this place through some friends and wasn't disappointed. Everything was great and priced cheap! Driver was a really nice guy, I think his name was nikky. Delivery was fast and still steaming when we got it. 5 stars I'll be ordering again soon!
Staff and owner are very friendly and food is great. I especially like having to order the shrimp pad Thai. I've been going here many times ever since I found the place.

I come here for lunch on occasion and have never been disappointed. The lunch special is $8 and the portions are a good size. I have always gotten the take out so I cannot comment on the service inside. The same lady takes my order every time I call and she is very friendly. The food is always hot and ready when she says. It is definitely worth a try.
Apple and Nicky are the best. I love everything they make. From the curry to the noodles. My favorite is the pad see ew

We don't live in the area, but my wife and I were down for the weekend and dropped by this place because it was nearby on yelp. We love Thai food and have tried many places, but this had simply the best Thai Curry I have ever had. The owner was very attentive and genuinely friendly. Would highly recommend to anyone looking for great Thai food! Wishing this business owner the best of luck with the new restaurant!

I used to love this place, but the current management seems to be making some poor decisions lately. For one they used to have duck curry, and when we ordered last night they said they no longer have it. While I liked Duck Curry I'm sure there could be other reasons why they no longer carry it. The bigger misstep is the size of their rice. We used to order 1 side of rice, and it was plenty for two orders of curry. Last night I ordered 2 curries and rice, and it was never mentioned to me this change, or at least letting me know one rice won't be enough for 2 curries. When the Order came the rice was in a tiny cup. I called up, and admittedly I was frustrated, and I got rude. They offered to send me another rice free of charge, thank you, but even with the 2nd little cup it was not enough. I imagine the rice is the least expensive thing for them, and for them to get stingy on their portions seems silly. I don't plan on ordering from them again because of this, since to me the rice is an important part of the meal. I wonder how many other customers they are losing over this to save a few pennies on rice.

Great food got the #79.Orange chicken and it was delicious and my husband got #35. I believe it's called Tom kha noodle soup had coconut flavor good size in portion. the owner she was very nice, inform us they just open and re model 4 days ago it's very clean and nice inside we will be going back very soon good food fair prices

If your a fan of thai food you came the right place. The new owner Apple is about as friendly as they come. The prices are very reasonable but more importantly the food is killer!! I get the spicy noodles every time and try something different to explore the menu. I have not been let down once. The curry dishes are fantastic. We like spice but medium is plenty. Great food, friendly people...how can you go wrong? Dont miss out on a hidden jewel.

Went here for the lunch special and the price for this amount and quality of food is awesome! The sweet and sour pork was cooked perfectly and the yellow curry had just the right amount of spice for my taste. Would really recommend!
This is my favorite Thai Food place. My husband and I've been coming here for about a year and every time we eat here or order take out is always delicious/great. The BEST Thai Food!
The food is great here and the Thai iced tea is delicious!! Love the cashew nut chicken and crab fried rice!
Great beef fried rice and Thai Tea. I've eaten here several times and tried several things. Haven't been disappointed. I was having trouble finding a good Thai place. Not anymore!

3rd times a charm...... I tried another dish. This time it was the Drunken Noodles. I've heard a lot of people talking about it, so I figured I would give it a shot. It was delicious even though I don't like green bell peppers. I picked them out and then devoured the noodles with shrimp. Another 5 star selection.......

I'm a BIG fan of Thai food, I have been one for the last 25 years or so. When I worked at the miracle mile near downtown LA, my ex boss used to treat us to lunch every Thursday and my co-worker a Thai girl knew where to go in Thai town to get us the most tasty and fresh Thai food, since then, I developed a taste for it, so I consider myself someone who knows what a good tasting, fresh and original Thai food should taste like. Today as I was driving to pick up my son from school in Grabada Hills, since I had an hour or so to spare, and it was lunch time, I had decided to stop at the subway on Balboa and Chatsworth, as I'm walking tours subway, I noticed a new place next door to subway. "Spice Up Thai Eatery" For obvious reasons, I decided to go in. A sweet Thai lady greeted me, and we proceed to engage in conversation , when I saw her face I knew I have seen her some where, she proceed to say that perhaps in a Thai restaurant in Reseda where she worked, and in fact my husband and I went to that restaurant where Apple (that's her name) was our server. Long story short, as per her subjection, I ordered pad thai, lunch is $8.00 and includes a small salad, soup and your entrée. The salad, super fresh, the sour soup delish, and the pad thai made to order. From the greeting at the door, to the food, I give this place a 5 stars. Take it from someone who's been looking for an authentic, delicious, and budget friendly thai place here in the Valley! Come and try it for yourself, you won't regret it.

I literally had to write my first review after my experience at this place today. Went for dinner and paid 20 bucks for fried rice and crab rangoons. The front counter girl was so unprofessional and rude. Refused to give me extra sweet and sour sauce, literally held on to it. After being surprised by her actions, I even stated I would pay for it. I mean i just paid 20 dollars for my food (she literally tried to take sauce out of my hand). Then she charged me a buck each for the small containers of sauce. The food is not even good, rice was over cooked and crab rangoons were stuffed with cream cheese hardly any crab meat smh NEVER going back here!

Really flavorful and consistent. Very friendly staff. I think the food is much better since the change of ownership/restaurant name. Pad Thai is one of the best I've had, green curry is tasty, pineapple fried rice is another good one. They always get my order correct. All praise, no complaints.

Since my wife and I returned from thailand we've been on a hunt for great authentic thai food. This is it!! Best thai food in town. Not only is the food great but the service is amazing. Thank you Apple for a great dining experience.
Excellent , friendly service. I had order pad Thai shrimp with Thai tea with boba so so very good. Best Thai restaurant . Most certainly will return.

This is one of our go-to spots for vegetarian food. Apple readily accommodates our requests, and the food is incredible. There is a fine balance between the smoky and the sweet. Plus, the yellow curry is amazing--but be careful to tell them that you don't want it spicy if you can't handle the heat. We love ours mild, and they get it right every time.

They have the best tom yum noodle soup in the area! I have a hard time finding another place like this that sells good tom yum noodle soup. Their appetizers are good too! The down side is that parking is limited.
Lunch special is plentiful, pad thai sticky and sweet like I like it, Tom yum not too sour, overall really great lunch.

So my reviews are as follows. 2 stars: food, 1 professionalism, ambiance, service. I'm giving 1 star for food, 1 for professionalism, 1 for ambiance, 0 for service = 3 stars. Everything is closed right now so I'm just assuming that their ambiance and professionalism is good. I ordered Panang curry, pad Thai and an appetizer. The food is awesome and I will most likely order from here again BUT, of all the Thai places that I have eaten at, even in Thailand, I have not received curry by itself. I ordered curry for myself and pad Thai for my wife assuming that the curry will come with rice. Do they expect people to have curry by itself? Like just drink it? That's the only part of this order that really got me puzzled. I had to let my curry sit and cook rice to have with the curry. You expect to charge $11 for curry and not give rice with it? It makes no sense. I've cook curry myself and it does not cost even $5 to cook one serving of curry and even wayyy less than that to have one serving of rice. Other then that, the food is great... probably one of the best in the valley.
Best chicken fried rice in the area by far. Always tastes fresh with large chucks of peppers and onions. It's the one thing I order consistently. Also great service

Deliciousness! Their fresh spicy rolls and spicy beef salad were amazing, fresh and delicious! The pad Thai was perfectly flavored! Great little gem in the area! The people seem really nice too... the owner is the sweetest! :)

Great food, horrible parking. They're almost buried in the corner of a tiny strip mall and parking is tight, but the food is worth it. They make the best garlic beef of any thai restaurant I've visited, and the pad thai and panang are good, too. Nice orange chicken as well. A regular take out spot for our family!

Placed an order 45 mins ahead of time and still wasn't ready when I got there. The guy went to the back to check my order, came back out never gave me an update, had to ask how much longer and simply told to sit down and wait, didn't even apologize.
Highly recommended, Omg I loved it, the food is great and the customer service is much better

we love to order food from this restaurant, they are very accommodating and patient when we placed our order. we are vegan and they prepare everything for us without any questions. the food is fresh and cooked to order. we are happy we found them so near to our house, they have also delivered food to us as well, free of charge. highly recommended this restaurant, keeping local family owned restaurans alive!!
Love everything on the menu that we've tried so far, but my favorites are the Panang Curry, pad see yew, and eggplant tofu.

First time ordering and I Must say it's pretty tasty. Ordered thru Yelp. Delivery was on time. Kinda disappointed with the amount of noodles received with my Rad Nah but it was yummy. I'd order again.

Was in the mood for thai food and just happened to be near by. The food was great and so was the service. Looking s a thai restaruant for good fried rice and we found it. I will be back when ever we are in the area.

New ownership with new cooks and crew. I had to try their tom yum seafood soup and i gotta tell ya out of all surrounding thai places within 2 mile radius they got the best and freshest tom yum. So its wonderful to have this new addition to the neighborhood. This is my new take out place. Just one request put the cat fish in chilli paste on the menu if possible. :)

Not too many people inside but it took about half hour for our first order to come up. Food was delivered to the table one at a time which i thought was kind of slow. We ordered shrimp dumplings for appetizer; it was ok. Bbq ribs was cold and tasted boiled instead. Rad na was watery but taste was good. Pad thai was a failure, tasted kinda spoiled to me. Soup was the best. Presentation was perfect. Service was 4/5. Items were overpriced compare to other thai restaurants. We were not satisfied, still a little hungry and ended up going to the soup/boba place behind them.
The orange chicken is amazing!!! The thai iced tea always hits the spot. Love getting take-out from Spice It Up. Great service, fast, and delicious.
Did not expect much when I came to eat here but the food is amazing. Delicious, and great portion size. The seating areas are also very comfortable. The wait usually is not long.

Fantasic Thai restaurant with great service and hospitality. Best orange chicken in the valley. Its rare to find thai food that tasted ad authentic as this. Eaten once in the restaurant and once delivery. Speedy delivery and the order was perfectly organized and complete. Highly recommend Spice Up Thai Eatery.

Haven't tried much from the menu after eating the pad see ew I don't think that I am gonna come back. The dish was overall really bland and the noodles were so white in color. For this dish, the noodles should be much darker than what I received. For what I ate, the flavor was very mediocre. The pad see ew I received looked nothing like the photos I've seen from their page. Have had better in this area from other places.

It is very difficult for me to get a Bangkok Thai restaurant who are willing to prepare food to my heat level. Jitlada and Lum Ka Naad will do it, but the perception that Americans can't or won't eat "spicy" food persists. I now have a third go-to restaurant I can count on. What's the good and the bad? The bad: The parking is a nightmare. There is a good possibility that you may have to park across the street in the Walgreens parking lot. The good: The food. We did take out. We did Papaya Salad, Tom Yum Soup (Hot and Sour), Panang Curry Chicken and Spicy Beef Thai Fried Rice. They were all good and had some heat to them. The flavors here a bit heavier than many of the Bangkok Thai restaurants we have tried in the SF Valley and that's a good thing. The flavors are more distinct and pungent. The Tom Yum Soup was a bit sweeter than I am used too, but the sour complimented it well. The Panang Curry was thick and rich. The Papaya Salad, crisp and refreshing. The Spicy Thai Fried Rice was darker and more flavorful than some of the others I have tried. How are the portions? Four dishes and two dinners later, we finished the food. Enough said. I wish they had Sai Oua. Try this place.
Ordered delivery via Yelp App. Fast, simple & easy to order. Food came fresh & hot. Tasted good. Would order again from here :)
Pad Thai was great and provided me enough for three meals! Thai iced tea was average but the sticky rice with mango dessert was pretty awesome.

This is my favorite place to go whenever I want some really good Thai food ! I love the food and the service here. When I come in hungry, I'll always come out full and satisfied after my meal. My family and I come to eat here all the time because we love it so much. If you want to try or eat some good food, this is the place to go. Guarantee, you'll love the food, and you'll want to come back again and again. The waiters and service are on point. Very kind and very good people. I'd never get tired of eating here. I recommend for others to come here and try it. It's the absolute best. :)) Definitely a 5 star restaurant.
This is the best Thai food in a while. Everyone was friendly and the service was great.

For a quick budget-minded lunch, this place was perfect. I had the pad thai off the "lunch special" menu ($8 for everything). The soup was a nice balance of sweet and spicy and the pad thai was good. Service was fast and very friendly. It is not a place I'd recommend for a nice dinner out as that's not the vibe, but it's great for what it is. Please consider parking on Chatsworth and walking a little bit. That little parking lot is almost always a nightmare.
It's a little hole-in-the-wall that offers great food at a great price! Not to mention, the service is amazing as well!

When I order the noodles here, I win. Order two or three different kinds of noodles. The freebie when you order over $20 is also very cool. Last time they sent pot stickers. Yum! They're very affordable and they deliver for free. Yay!
I had the spicy beef salad and it was delicious.!!!! The server Apple was friendly. They also do deliveries!!

Meh! This place was so much better with the previous owner. I ordered a large order to be delivered. They told me 45-1hr wait. An hr and a half later I had to call the restaurant for an update. The lady's response was that they are "too busy" and the driver was "on his way." I live on the same block ;-/ how long can it take? Also, they forgot all the condiments. The food was just okay. The meat plates had more veggies than meat. Will not order again.
Excellent food at great prices! Soups are especially delicious! And Apple is the best server!
Decided to give it a try since its grand opening and its really goood my bf and i tried the pork bbq ribs and they were made to perfection. Will definitely be back!

The pan fried noodles are excellent, but the barbecued ribs are outstanding. A lot of food, all excellent. The only minor problem is parking. It shares a small lot with a 7-11 and Subway, but there is a big lot across the street.
I love this place, I came here after a friend of mine told me to come here! The food is amazing and I love the fries wontons as a appetizer! I would high recommend coming here!!

Food is delicious and service is great. The first item I had was the tom yum soup, I was feeling under the weather, and this did not disappoint. I wanted to come back again and this time I got mongolian beef, it was also very tasty. I'll definitely be coming back more often. It's a perk that it's near by!

I had the panang curry here and I liked the flavors quite a bit. Rich with a good amount of spice. The presentation is simple, though the colors were vivid. The server is friendly and no doubt working hard to provide quick service. I also had the crab Rangoon which I enjoyed as well. The cream cheese worked well with the crab. I will definitely come back and try the other menu items.
The food is amazing and the service was great. Love the spicey noodle and pad see eww!

Very friendly and thoughtful service here! Had the Mongolian beef, BBQ pork ribs, and Tom Yum Shrimp soup. Best was definitely the tom yum soup. The soup base is prepared with all the traditional ingredients and definitely hits the spot in cold weather. I recommend this place to people looking for a cozy place out of the rain to warm up!
I went here and got pad thai with tofu. It was probably one of my favorite pad thais in the valley! Very good place
